cards.name: Gwendolyn (G2)
cards.title: Inner Circle
cards.text: Camarilla Brujah Inner Circle: +2 bleed.

cards.name: Gwendolyn Fleming (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Gwenllian Arwyn (G6)
cards.text: Camarilla: During an action she performs, Gwenllian can burn 1 blood to give a blocking vampire -1 intercept. +1 strength.

cards.name: Gwyedd (G4)
cards.title: Primogen
cards.text: Camarilla primogen: Lock any younger vampire who attempted and failed to block an undirected action (successful or not) Gwyedd performed, after resolution.

cards.name: Gypsies
cards.text:
Unique mortal with 1 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
Gypsies get +1 stealth on each of their actions.
cards.flavor:
...the gradations of the dark
were like an underworld of death,
but for the spark
in the Gypsy boy's black eyes.
Edward Thomas, "The Gypsy"

cards.name: Haakon Mortensen (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: During your unlock phase, you can move 1 blood from Haakon to any Gangrel or Gangrel antitribu in your uncontrolled region. Haakon can take an action to move 1 blood from the blood bank to any unlocked vampire.

cards.name: Hackerspace
cards.text:
Location.
This card comes into play with 1 counter for each Anarch you control. After an Anarch comes into play under your control, or after a vampire you control becomes Anarch, add 1 counter to this card. An Anarch you control can use these counters to pay some or all of the blood or pool cost of an equipment they equip.

cards.name: Hadrian Garrick (G2)
cards.text: Independent: +1 strength.

cards.name: Hafsa, The Watcher (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla: Camarilla vampires must burn 1 blood to attempt to block Hafsa. Assamites get +1 bleed against you. Blood cursed.

cards.name: Hafthor Thorsteinsson (G7)
cards.text: Anarch: +1 intercept.

cards.name: Hag's Wrinkles
cards.text:
Only usable during an equip action.
[obf] +2 stealth.
[thn] Unlock this vampire after action resolution if this action is successful.
[THN] As [thn] above, but with +1 stealth.
cards.flavor:
People look twice when you go in a posh place like that, but let 'em look. They'll never catch you lifting because they don't know what they're looking for.
Reg Driscoll, Samedi

cards.name: Hagar Stone (G5)
cards.text: Sabbat: While Hagar is ready, you get +1 hand size. While he is unlocked, you do not replace cards you play during your turn until he locks or your turn ends. Black Hand.

cards.name: Halim Bey (G4)
cards.text: Independent: While Halim is ready, mummies you control get +1 stealth.

cards.name: Hall of Hades' Court
cards.text:
Only usable during the polling step of a political action.
[dom] [ACTION MODIFIER] Requires a vampire with capacity 5 or more. This vampire gets +2 votes.
[tem] [ACTION MODIFIER][REACTION] Cancel a reaction card as it is played by a younger vampire without Temporis [tem], and its cost is not paid.
[TEM] [ACTION MODIFIER][REACTION] Multiplier. Only usable by a ready unlocked vampire other than the acting vampire. The acting vampire's votes are doubled when tallying results. Only one multiplier can be played on a vampire each action.

cards.name: Hall of Mirrors
cards.text:
Only usable during the first round of combat.
[chi] Maneuver.
[CHI] This vampire burns 1 blood to cancel the opposing minion's strike card as it is played, and its cost is not paid (the minion chooses another strike). A vampire can play only one Hall of Mirrors at superior each combat.

cards.name: Hamid Mansour (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Hand Contract
cards.text:
Master. Contract. Trifle.
Put this card on any ready minion and choose a Black Hand vampire. That Black Hand vampire may enter combat with the minion with this card as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action unless they are controlled by the same Methuselah.

cards.name: Hand Intervention
cards.text:
Requires a titled Sabbat vampire.
Choose a Methuselah. If this referendum is successful, put this card in play. The chosen Methuselah has -1 hand size. That Methuselah may burn this card by burning the Edge. A Methuselah may be chosen for only one Hand Intervention at a time.

cards.name: Hand of Conrad
cards.text:
Unique.
This vampire gets superior Potence [POT]. This vampire can move a vampire from your ash heap to your uncontrolled region as an action.

cards.name: Handsome Dan (G6)
cards.text: Anarch: Flight [FLIGHT].

cards.name: Hanging Fermata
cards.text:
Out-of-turn. Only usable during your influence phase. Not usable if you played a Hanging Fermata during your last turn.
No cards named /Choir/ are burned during this influence phase.
cards.flavor:
If music be the food of love, play on;
Give me excess of it, that, surfeiting,
The appetite may sicken, and so die.
William Shakespeare, "Twelfth Night", act I, scene 1

cards.name: Hanna Nokelainen (G6)
cards.text: Anarch.

cards.name: Hanna Redmonds (G3)
cards.text: Camarilla: An older vampire opposing Hanna gets one optional maneuver or press on the first round of combat.

cards.name: Hannibal (G2 ADV)
cards.title: Cardinal
cards.text: Sabbat cardinal: During each Methuselah's minion phase, Hannibal can burn 2 blood to unlock.

cards.name: Hannibal (G2)
cards.title: Cardinal
cards.text: Sabbat cardinal: Hannibal can steal up to 2 blood from a Sabbat vampire as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Hannigan (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Haqim's Law: Judgment
cards.text:
Contract. Trifle.
Lock a ready Independent or Anarch Assamite you control to put this card on a younger vampire. Every Independent or Anarch Assamite is considered chosen for this contract. Any Independent or Anarch Assamite can enter combat with the attached vampire as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Haqim's Law: Leadership
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
Each Methuselah who controls any of the oldest ready Assamites gains 2 pool.
cards.flavor:
Leadership is an action, not a position.
Donald H. McGannon

cards.name: Haqim's Law: Retribution
cards.text: Put this card in play. During a bleed action, an Assamite you control can discard a combat card to get +1 bleed.

cards.name: Harass
cards.text: Ⓓ Enter combat with a vampire who has 3 or fewer blood or with a locked minion. This acting minion gets 1 optional press, only usable to continue combat, during that combat.

cards.name: Hard Case
cards.text:
Only usable when this vampire successfully blocks an ally or younger vampire.
[for] Cancel the resulting combat.
[FOR] As above, and destroy a weapon or vehicle on the acting minion.

cards.name: Hardestadt (G4)
cards.title: Inner Circle
cards.text: Camarilla Ventrue Inner Circle: Any vampire contesting Hardestadt's title must yield during their unlock phase. +1 bleed. +2 strength.

cards.name: Harika Guljan (G2)
cards.text: Independent: Blood cursed.

cards.name: Harlan Graves (G6)
cards.text: Independent: If Harlan is diablerized, no blood hunt can be called. He gets -1 intercept during non-bleed actions.

cards.name: Harmony
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
Ⓓ Your prey burns 3 pool for each card named /Choir/ you control. Burn all those cards.
cards.flavor:
Their songs are at once captivating and deadly — much like I suspect the Sirens to be themselves.
Jan Pieterzoon, Ventrue

cards.name: Harold Tanner (G4)
cards.text: Camarilla: The controller of the minion in combat with Harold plays with an open hand.

cards.name: Harold Zettler, Pentex Director (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: Giovanni get +1 bleed against you. +1 stealth.

cards.name: Harrod (G2)
cards.title: Inner Circle
cards.text: Camarilla Nosferatu Inner Circle: During your unlock phase, you may look at a card in your prey's uncontrolled region. +2 bleed.

cards.name: Harry Reese (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat: Damage-dealing strikes Harry makes against non-mortal allies are at +1 damage.

cards.name: Hartmut Stover (G3)
cards.title: Archbishop
cards.text: Sabbat Archbishop of Berlin: Any vampire casting votes or ballots against a referendum called by Hartmut burns 1 blood once results are tallied. You can burn the Edge during your discard phase to gain 1 pool.

cards.name: Harvest Rites
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a Sabbat vampire.
Put this card on this vampire. Once each turn, when this vampire successfully hunts, they gain 1 additional blood. A vampire can have only one Harvest Rites.

cards.name: Harzomatuili
cards.text:
Requires a ready cardinal or regent. Unique werewolf with 4 life. 2 strength, 0 bleed.
Harzomatuili gets one optional maneuver each combat. Damage from his hand strikes is aggravated. Once during a directed action, he can burn 1 life to get +1 intercept. If Harzomatuili has fewer than 4 life during your unlock phase, he gains 1 life from the blood bank.

cards.name: Hasani (G4)
cards.text: Laibon.

cards.name: Hasina Kesi (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla: Burn 1 pool each time Hasina goes into torpor.

cards.name: Hatch the Viper
cards.text:
Retainer with 1 life.
[pro][ser] The employer can prevent 1 damage each combat. Hatch the Viper inflicts 1 damage on the opposing minion each round of combat during normal strike resolution at close range.
[PRO][SER] As above, but it inflicts 2 damage.

cards.name: Hatchling
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a non-sterile Gargoyle.
Put this card into play. This card represents a 1-capacity Gargoyle of the same sect with basic Visceratika [vis]. Move 1 blood from the bank to this Gargoyle. This Gargoyle cannot act this turn. Once this game, this Gargoyle can burn 1 blood during your unlock phase to gain flight [FLIGHT].

cards.name: Haunt
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Put this card on a location you control. You can burn this card to have an action directed at the attached location fail. A location can have only one Haunt.
[NEC] Ⓓ Burn a location that does not require Giovanni to play.

cards.name: Haven Affinity
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card on a Tzimisce. If this Tzimisce blocks, they can play combat cards during the resulting combat as if they had the superior level of all their Disciplines.

cards.name: Haven Hunting
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires an anarch.
Put this card in play. At the end of a combat involving an anarch you control, if both combatants are still ready, you may burn this card to have the two combatants begin another combat.

cards.name: Haven Uncovered
cards.text: Put this card on a ready vampire. Minions can enter combat with this vampire as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. This vampire can burn this card as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.
cards.flavor:
Come burrow through my ruins, shed not a tear.
Charles Baudelaire, "The Gladly Dead"

cards.name: Hawg
cards.text:
Vehicle.
The minion with this vehicle gets an optional press each combat. A minion may have only 1 vehicle.

cards.name: Hay Ride
cards.text:
Only usable after action resolution (successful or not).
[san] Choose a Blood Brother of the same circle as this Blood Brother. As your next action, the chosen Blood Brother can play the action card used for this action from your ash heap as if from your hand.
[SAN] As above, but this card costs 1 fewer blood.

cards.name: Haymaker
cards.text:
Play after range is determined. Only usable at close range. Not usable if this minion played a Haymaker last round.
This minion's initial strike this round will be strike: hand strike at +1 damage, and the opposing minion's initial strike this round gets first strike. If either minion inflicts more damage than the other this round, that minion gets an optional press this round.

cards.name: Hazimel (G4)
cards.title: 2 votes
cards.text: Independent. 2 votes (titled): Non-Ravnos vampires must burn 2 blood to announce an action (if it is not canceled as played) directed at Hazimel or a card or counter on him. +1 bleed.

cards.name: Healing Touch
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[cel] Unlock a younger vampire you control.
[obe] Add up to 2 life to an ally, not to exceed their starting life.
[OBE] Rescue a vampire from torpor. The rescued vampire gains 1 blood.

cards.name: Heart of Darkness
cards.text:
[ser] Put this card on this vampire. This vampire treats aggravated damage as normal damage. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action.
[SER] As above, and this vampire can prevent 1 damage each combat.

cards.name: Heart of Nizchetus
cards.text:
Unique.
If the bearer is ready during your unlock phase, you can draw up to 3 cards without discarding and then move the same number of cards from your hand to the bottom of your library.
cards.flavor:
Occasionally, I think I see it beat. Just dancing shadows, perhaps, but fortune follows.
Radu Bistri, Tzimisce

cards.name: Heart of the City
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[pre] Put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +1 bleed. A vampire can have only one Heart of the City.
[PRE] As above, but this vampire gets +2 bleed.
cards.flavor:
We are each our own devil, and we make this world our hell.
Oscar Wilde

cards.name: Heart's Desire
cards.text:
Only usable during a bleed action.
[aus][chi] +1 bleed (limited). If an ally or younger vampire is currently attempting to block this action, that attempt fails and the blocking minion cannot attempt to block this action again.
[AUS][CHI] As above, but with +2 bleed (limited).

cards.name: Heartblood of the Clan
cards.text:
Unique location.
Any Assamite can add 1 blood to this card as an action. During your influence phase, you can move any amount of blood from this card to an Assamite in your uncontrolled region.

cards.name: Heartrender
cards.text:
Unique wraith with 1 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
The Heartrender can remove itself from the game to burn a non-wraith non-zombie ally or retainer as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Heather Florent, The Opportunist (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla: If you gain pool from the Edge, you may move it to Heather (instead of putting it in your pool).

cards.name: Heaven's Gate
cards.text:
Only usable by a ready unlocked vampire not involved in the combat.
[nec] Prevent 1 damage to an ally in combat.
[obe] Only usable if an ally would be burned in combat. Instead, they gain 1 life if they have no life, and they cannot enter (or be involved in) combat, perform actions, or block this turn; end combat.
[OBE] As [obe] above, but add 2 life if they have no life, not to exceed their starting life.

cards.name: Hecate (G5)
cards.text: Sabbat: You can burn the top card of the target Methuselah's library after Hecate bleeds successfully.

cards.name: Hector Sosa (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Hector Trelane (G4)
cards.text: Independent: On the first round of combat, Hector can use strikes that require Blood Sorcery [tha] that are not usable on the first round. If Hector is sent to torpor or burned in combat, he is burned, and the controller of the opposing minion gains 4 pool.

cards.name: Hedonism
cards.text:
Only usable by a ready unlocked vampire other than the acting minion if a minion attempts to block.
[for] or [pre] That attempt fails and the blocking minion cannot attempt to block this action again. Lock this vampire and the blocking minion, and queue a combat between them.
[FOR] or [PRE] As above, but queue no combat.

cards.name: Heidelberg Castle, Germany
cards.text:
Unique location.
Lock to move blood, equipment and/or retainers between any two ready vampires you control. Cannot be used during an action.
cards.flavor:
Night. Rain. The lurid sky that lets
The spires and towers show grey silhouettes
Of an old Gothic town by distance dimmed.
Paul Verlaine, "Night Effect"

cards.name: Heinrick Schlempt (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Hekla "Bonecrusher" Jónasdóttir (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Hektor (G4)
cards.title: Priscus
cards.text: Sabbat priscus: Damage from Hektor's hand strikes is aggravated. Baali get +1 bleed when bleeding you.

cards.name: Hel-Blá (G6)
cards.text: Independent: Hel-Blá can move an ally requiring Hecata or Oblivion [obl] from your ash heap to your ready region, locked with life equal to its starting life as a +1 stealth action that costs 1 blood.

cards.name: Helen Fairchild (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat: Helen cannot have or use equipment. Sterile.

cards.name: Helena (G3 ADV)
cards.text:
Independent: Helena pays no blood costs for reaction cards requiring Auspex [aus] or Dominate [dom]. Infernal.
[MERGED] Helena is immune to damage from demons and gets +1 level of Daimoinon [dai] and Obtenebration [obt].

cards.name: Helena (G3)
cards.text: Camarilla: If Helena is locked and ready, she can burn a blood to be able to attempt to block and/or play reaction cards that require Auspex [aus] as if unlocked for the remainder of the action. +1 bleed.

cards.name: Helena Casimir (G1)
cards.title: Primogen
cards.text: Camarilla primogen: +1 bleed.

cards.name: Helicopter
cards.text:
Vehicle.
When a minion equips with the Helicopter, lock it. After resolving a successful action, this minion may lock the Helicopter to unlock. A minion may have only one vehicle.
cards.flavor:
We'll take a helicopter. There and back in a night.
Hesha Ruhadze, Follower of Set

cards.name: Hell-for-Leather
cards.text:
Requires an Anarch. Only one Hell-for-Leather can be played at a given Discipline each combat.
[ani] Strike: dodge, with 1 additional strike (limited).
[cel] Additional strike that does not count against the limit.
[obt] Only usable if this Anarch is ready and the opposing minion is not. The opposing minion's controller burns 2 pool.

cards.name: Hellhound
cards.text:
Ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
The Hellhound cannot take actions. If the Hellhound has only 1 life during your unlock phase, it gains 1 life from the blood bank.

cards.name: Henri Lavenant (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat: While Henri is in combat, you get +1 hand size. Black Hand.

cards.name: Henry Taylor (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat: After an action, you may move a combat card Henry played during that action from your ash heap to the top of your library.

cards.name: Herald of Topheth
cards.text:
Demon with 5 life. 3 strength, 1 bleed, flight [FLIGHT]. Infernal.
Herald of Topheth can play cards requiring basic Daimoinon [dai], basic Potence [pot] and/or basic Presence [pre] as a vampire with capacity 5. It can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action. If it has 4 or fewer life during your unlock phase, it gains 1 life.

cards.name: Herbert Westin (G4)
cards.text: Camarilla: You can draw 1 card after Herbert performs a successful equip action (discard down afterward).

cards.name: Hermana Hambrienta Mayor (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat. Mexico City Circle: Hermanas are not unique. When moved to the ready region in your influence phase, this vampire burns 2 blood or is burned.

cards.name: Hermana Hambrienta Menor (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat. Mexico City Circle: Hermanas are not unique. When moved to the ready region in your influence phase, this vampire burns 2 blood or is burned.

cards.name: Heroic Might
cards.text:
+3 stealth action.
[pot] Put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +1 strength. This vampire can strike: burn equipment. Burn this card if this vampire is in torpor. A vampire can have only one Heroic Might.
[POT] As above, with an additional +1 strength, and this vampire can strike: 2R damage.

cards.name: Hesha Ruhadze (G2)
cards.text: Independent: Hesha gets +1 stealth when hunting. +1 hunt.

cards.name: Hesha Ruhadze (G6)
cards.text: Anarch: Hesha gets +1 bleed for each unique equipment attached to him.

cards.name: Hester Reed (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Hexaped
cards.text:
Ally with 3 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Hexaped may give a link counter to any Methuselah as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. Remove Hexaped from the game if that action succeeds. The Tremere antitribu who recruited it gets +1 bleed and +1 stealth when bleeding the Methuselah with that link counter.

cards.name: Hexe
cards.text:
[dai] Strike: 2R damage.
[str] Strike: 1R aggravated damage. [str] is not a Discipline.
[STR] As [str] above, and the damage is unpreventable.

cards.name: Hezekiah Rutledge (G4)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Hidden Lurker
cards.text:
Only usable by a ready unlocked vampire other than the acting minion. Only usable after a combat between the acting minion you control and a blocking minion.
[obf] Lock this vampire. This vampire enters combat with the blocking minion. The first round of this new combat, the blocking minion cannot strike.
[OBF] As above, with an optional press.

cards.name: Hidden Pathways
cards.text:
[obf] Put this card in play. Your minions get +1 stealth on non-bleeding actions directed at your prey. Any minion may burn this card as a Ⓓ action. A Methuselah may have only one Hidden Pathways in play.
[OBF] As above, but playing this card is a +1 stealth action.

cards.name: Hidden Strength
cards.text:
[for] Prevent X+1 damage.
[FOR] As above, with 1 optional press.

cards.name: Hide
cards.text:
Not usable by an imbued with Illuminate.
[ACTION MODIFIER] [1 CONVICTION] Only usable as the action is announced. Monsters get -1 intercept against this action.
[REACTION] [1 CONVICTION] Only usable during a monster's action directed at this imbued. The action fails.
cards.flavor:
The surgical strike is better. Do damage. Disappear. Repeat.
Joshua "God45" Matthews, Wayward

cards.name: Hide the Heart
cards.text:
[aus] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[val] The action fails, unless the acting minion burns 1 blood. Only one Hide the Heart can be played at [val] each action.
[VAL] Reduce a bleed against you by 2, or lock to reduce a bleed against any Methuselah by 2.

cards.name: Hide the Mind
cards.text:
[obf] [COMBAT] Cancel a combat card requiring Auspex [aus] as it is played, and its cost is not paid.
[OBF] [ACTION MODIFIER] Cancel a reaction card requiring Auspex as it is played, and its cost is not paid.

cards.name: Hiding in the Open
cards.text:
Requires a Laibon.
If this referendum succeeds, put this card on the acting Laibon. This Laibon gets +1 bleed. Cards which require a non-Laibon title cannot be played on this Laibon nor while this Laibon is acting. A minion may have only one Hiding in the Open.

cards.name: Hierophant
cards.text: Choose any Follower of Set. Successful referendum means this card is put on the chosen vampire. This vampire gets +1 vote. If a vampire blocks this vampire, the blocking vampire burns 1 blood before block resolution.

cards.name: High Aye
cards.text:
Requires a Laibon with three or more Aye.
+1 stealth, +2 stealth if this action is undirected. If the action succeeds, you may discard up to two cards from your hand (draw afterward).

cards.name: High Ground
cards.text: Maneuver, only usable to go to long range. If this minion has flight [FLIGHT] and the opposing minion does not, play before range is determined to set the range for the round to long. A minion may play only one High Ground each round.

cards.name: High Museum of Art, Atlanta
cards.text:
Master: unique location.
Gain 4 pool when you put this card into play or gain control of it. Any vampire can steal this location for his or her controller as a Ⓓ action. Burn 4 pool when you lose control of the High Museum (including when it is burned or becomes contested).

cards.name: High Orun
cards.text:
Requires a Laibon with three or more Orun.
For the remainder of this action, cards that require any Disciplines cost this Laibon 1 less blood, and your hand size is one card larger.
cards.flavor:
As nightfall does not come at once, neither does oppression... it is in such twilight that we all must be aware of change in the air -- however slight -- lest we become victims of the darkness.
William O. Douglas

cards.name: High Priest Angra Mainyu (G2)
cards.text: Independent: While Angra is ready, your prey gets -1 hand size. During a non-bleed action, he can burn the Edge to get +1 stealth. Infernal.

cards.name: High Stakes
cards.text: Only usable if playing for ante. Successful referendum means each Methuselah decides whether to ante the next card in his or her library or be ousted from the game. Decisions should be made simultaneously, as follows: each Methuselah holds out a hand with zero or one blood in it. Open hands simultaneously. A pool in a Methuselah's hand indicates that he or she chooses not to be ousted.

cards.name: High Top
cards.text:
Unique werewolf with 3 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
High Top gets +1 intercept. High Top may enter combat with any minion controlled by another Methuselah as a Ⓓ action. High Top gets an additional strike (limited) each round and an optional maneuver once each combat. He may play cards requiring basic Celerity [cel] as a vampire with a capacity of 4. If High Top has less than 3 life during your unlock phase, he gains 1 life.

cards.name: Highway Haven: RV
cards.text:
Vehicle. Haven.
This minion gets an optional press to end combat on the first round of combat. If the bearer is an anarch, any vampire attempting an action directed at this anarch doesn't unlock as normal on his or her next unlock phase (even if the action isn't successful). Any werewolf may burn this equipment and enter combat with this minion as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. A minion may have only one haven and only one vehicle.
cards.flavor:
The greatest haven is motion.
Stephen Lenoir, Lasombra antitribu

cards.name: Hillanvale (G6)
cards.text: Independent: During a bleed action, Hillanvale can burn 1 blood and discard a card requiring Melpominee [mel] to get +1 bleed. She gets -1 intercept against non-Independent, non-Anarch vampires.

cards.name: Hiram "Hide" DeVries (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla: While Hiram is ready, actions to burn a location you control cost 1 additional blood.

cards.name: Hiromitsu Asano (G6)
cards.text: Independent.

cards.name: Hive Mind
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[san] Unlock this Blood Brother and another ready Blood Brother of the same circle. Only one Hive Mind can be played at [san] each turn.
[SAN] Add 3 blood to a Blood Brother of the same circle in your uncontrolled region.

cards.name: Holliday "Burgundy" Hall (G6)
cards.text: Independent.

cards.name: Homa (G4)
cards.text: Laibon.

cards.name: Homunculus
cards.text:
Retainer with 1 life.
[pro] During any Methuselah's unlock phase, the employer can burn 1 blood to unlock.
[PRO] As above, but Homunculus has 2 life.
cards.flavor:
A pile of bones in a skin bag, a deflated balloon; a hideous bundle.
R. Chetwynd-Hayes, "Looking For Something To Suck"

cards.name: Honest Abe (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Honor the Elders
cards.text: Successful referendum means each ready vampire with capacity of 8 or more gains 1 blood from the blood bank, and each vampire with capacity of 8 or more in any uncontrolled region gains 1 blood from the blood bank.

cards.name: Honorine Ateba (G4)
cards.text: Laibon.

cards.name: Horace Radcliffe (G6)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Horatio (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Horatio Ballard (G3)
cards.text: Camarilla: If Horatio doesn't have a title, he can call a referendum to become the Prince of Chicago as a +1 stealth political action.

cards.name: Horrid Form
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[vic] This vampire gets +1 strength this combat.
[VIC] As above, and this vampire can prevent 1 damage each round.
cards.flavor:
Whence and what art thou, execrable shape?
John Milton, "Paradise Lost"

cards.name: Horrid Reality
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[chi] Equip this vampire with the first weapon you find in your library (working down from the top; shuffle afterward; if the requirements are not met, it is burned). This weapon does not contest any card in play. Do not pay the cost for this weapon. At the end of this combat, burn the weapon if it is still in play.
[CHI] As above, but shuffle the equipment into your library at the end of combat if it is still in play.

cards.name: Horrific Countenance
cards.text:
Only usable when this vampire is blocked.
[pro] Unlock the blocking minion. This action is not blocked, and it is now unblockable.

cards.name: Horrock (G3)
cards.text: Independent: Protean [pro] cards cost Horrock 1 less blood.

cards.name: Horseshoes
cards.text:
[pot] Ⓓ Inflict 1 unpreventable damage on a ready minion.
[POT] Ⓓ Inflict 2 unpreventable damage on a ready minion.

cards.name: Horst von Brühl (G6)
cards.title: Prince
cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Mannheim.

cards.name: Hospital Food
cards.text:
Master: unique location. Requires a ready anarch.
Lock when an anarch announces a hunting action. If that action is successful, the anarch gains an additional blood.
cards.flavor:
It's easy work. Just eyeball the donor's chart before snacking so you don't get a sour one.
Sandra White, Caitiff anarch

cards.name: Hostile Takeover
cards.text:
Master.
Choose a vampire with capacity of 6 or less. Each Methuselah bids pool for control of that vampire. The highest bid goes to the vampire's controller; that bidder then takes control of the vampire. If the controller wins, half the winning bid (rounded up) goes to the blood bank.

cards.name: Houngan
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card on a ready Samedi you control. During your unlock phase, this Samedi gains 1 blood from the bank, and he or she may lock to gain an additional blood. Any other Samedi may move this card to himself or herself as a +1 stealth action.

cards.name: Hourglass of the Mind
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[pot] Draw 3 cards (discard down afterward).
[tem] Draw 4 cards without discarding, then move four cards from your hand to the top of your library in any order. Unlock this vampire.
[TEM] Put this card on this vampire. During your unlock phase, this vampire can burn 2 blood to add 1 counter to this card. While this vampire is ready, you get +1 hand size for each counter on this card.

cards.name: House of Sorrow
cards.text:
Master: unique location.
Lock to unlock any card you control that is not a minion. If you do so, neither that card nor this location unlock as normal on your next unlock phase.

cards.name: Howler (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Howler gets 1 optional maneuver each combat. She cannot use weapons. +1 strength. Sterile.

cards.name: Hrothulf (G3)
cards.text: Camarilla: If you control the Edge, Hrothulf can burn it to enter combat with a ready minion controlled by another Methuselah as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Huang, Blood Cultist (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Any Gangrel antitribu can enter combat with Huang as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Hugo (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Hugo gets -1 intercept against Lasombra and Tzimisce.

cards.name: Huitzilopochtli (G2)
cards.text: Independent: If Huitzilopochtli is ready during your master phase, you can burn 1 pool to get +1 master phase action. Infernal. +1 bleed.

cards.name: Hukros (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: During your unlock phase, you may move a card from your hand to Hukros face down. You may look at the card at any time. Hukros may play that card as if from your hand.

cards.name: Huldu, The Desecrator (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat: Once each combat involving another minion you control, if Huldu is ready, she can burn 1 blood to prevent 1 damage to that minion. +1 bleed.

cards.name: Humanitas
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card on a ready vampire you control. When attempting to rescue a vampire from torpor, this vampire gets +1 stealth and burns 1 less blood if successful. This vampire cannot commit diablerie.

cards.name: Humo (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: If you also control Greensleeves and he is ready, Humo may burn a blood to give Greensleeves +1 stealth once each action.

cards.name: Hunger Moon
cards.text: If a vampire successfully hunts, move 1 blood from that vampire to this card after resolution. Burn this card if it has 5 blood.

cards.name: Hunger of Marduk
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[tha] This round, this vampire can strike, ranged: steal 1 blood or life (becoming blood).
[THA] As above, but for 2 blood or life (becoming blood).

cards.name: Hunter's Mark
cards.text:
[cel][tha] Ⓓ Enter combat with a minion. This acting vampire gets 1 optional press during that combat.
[CEL][THA] As above, and the opposing minion cannot strike: combat ends during the first round of that combat.

cards.name: Hunting the Beast
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[aus] Ⓓ Enter combat with a vampire.
[AUS] As above, and at the end of that combat, if this vampire is ready and the opposing vampire is not, add 2 blood to a Salubri in your uncontrolled region.

cards.name: Hunting the Quarry
cards.text:
Only usable if both combatants are still ready. A vampire can play only one Hunting the Quarry each combat.
[cel] or [tha] Only usable if combat is about to end. Put this card on the opposing minion. You still control this card. Vampires you control can burn this card to attempt to enter combat with the attached minion as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.
[CEL] or [THA] Only usable if combat would end. Instead, this vampire burns 1 blood to start a new round.

cards.name: Husamettin (G2)
cards.text: Independent: After Husamettin burns a vampire with a contract on them, you can search your library for a master Discipline card and put it on him (shuffle afterward). Blood cursed.

cards.name: I am Legion
cards.text:
[dai] +1 stealth.
[dai][obf] Cancel a reaction card requiring Auspex [aus] as it is played (cost must be paid).
[DAI][OBF] As [dai][obf] above, and/or gain 1 pool after action resolution if this action is successful.

cards.name: Iago Castille (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat: +1 intercept.

cards.name: Ian Carfax (G7)
cards.title: Justicar
cards.text: Camarilla Tremere Justicar: Once each turn after a combat involving Ian ends, he can unlock if the opposing minion is not ready. +1 intercept.

cards.name: Ian Forestal (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Ian may play cards that require a Discipline as though he has the basic level of that Discipline. Each Master: Discipline card placed on him gives him the superior level of that Discipline.

cards.name: Ian Wallingford (G2)
cards.title: Bishop
cards.text: Sabbat bishop.

cards.name: Ibn Khaldun, Scholar (G4)
cards.text: Independent: During your discard phase, Ibn Khaldun can burn 1 blood to unlock. He cannot use cards requiring Celerity [cel]. Scarce.

cards.name: Icarus, The Manchurian (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: When Icarus bleeds a Methuselah successfully, you may look at that Methuselah's hand.

cards.name: Idalia, Prophet of Guadalajara (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: If Idalia performs a successful equip action, she can unlock during the next discard phase.

cards.name: Idrissa (G4)
cards.text: Laibon.

cards.name: Ignacio, The Black Priest (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Ignatius (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Ignazio Giovanni (G3)
cards.text: Independent: Ignazio can enter combat with a vampire with capacity 6 or less controlled by your predator or prey as a Ⓓ action. +1 strength.

cards.name: Ignis Fatuus
cards.text:
[chi] The acting minion gets -1 stealth until the end of the turn.
[CHI] Reduce a bleed against any Methuselah by 1.
cards.flavor:
Because there is safety in derision,
I talked about an apparition...
William Butler Yeats, "The Apparitions"

cards.name: Ignore the Searing Flames
cards.text:
[ser] Only usable if the opposing minion's strike inflicts aggravated damage on this vampire. This vampire treats all aggravated damage from that strike as normal damage.
[dai] Prevent all aggravated damage from the opposing minion's strike.
[DAI] Burn 1 blood to be immune to aggravated damage this round.

cards.name: Igo the Hungry (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla: Igo does not get the usual +1 stealth when hunting.

cards.name: Igoli's Loyalty
cards.text:
Only usable during a referendum, before votes and ballots are cast.
Starting with your prey and going clockwise, each Methuselah with any ready titled vampires may elect to cast all of his or her vampires' votes and ballots in favor for 1 pool. Each time a Methuselah declines, this Ishtarri burns 1 blood to add 1 pool to that amount. Continue until a Methuselah accepts or this Ishtarri fails to burn a blood. When results are tallied, each vampire casting votes or ballots against this referendum burns 2 blood.

cards.name: Iliana (G2)
cards.text: Camarilla: Contracts cannot be placed on Iliana.

cards.name: Ilias cel Frumos (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Illegal Search and Seizure
cards.text:
Master.
Burn a weapon that costs more than 2 pool or inflicts (with a regular strike) aggravated damage or more than 3 damage. The bearer of the weapon takes 1 damage. This damage cannot be prevented.

cards.name: Illegalism
cards.text:
Requires an Anarch. More than one Discipline can be used to play this card. Ⓓ Bleed.
[cel] Unlock this Anarch if the bleed is successful.
[chi] This is a +1 stealth action.
[pre] The bleed is with +1 bleed.

cards.name: Illuminate
cards.text: All imbued get +1 intercept when blocking monsters (not cumulative with any other Illuminate in play, nor with The Unmasking). Any monster may enter combat with this imbued as a Ⓓ action. Burn this card during your next unlock phase or if this imbued leaves the ready region.

cards.name: Illusions of the Kindred
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[chi] Combat ends. Move the bottom card from your crypt to your ready region. That minion does not contest any other minions or titles in play. That vampire gains blood equal to half their capacity rounded down. That vampire and the opposing minion enter combat. Remove that minion from the game at the end of combat (if they are still in play).
[CHI] As above, but that vampire gains blood equal to their capacity.

cards.name: Illusory Resources
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Unique.
[chi] Put this card in play with 1 counter. During your unlock phase, a ready vampire with Chimerstry [chi] you control can move 1 blood to this card. You can burn X counters from this card to reduce a bleed against you by X.
[CHI] As above, but this card comes into play with 2 counters.

cards.name: Ilomba
cards.text:
Animal with 1 life. Requires a Laibon.
Put Ilomba on any minion (this is a +1 stealth Ⓓ action if that minion is controlled by another Methuselah). If Ilomba would burn a life (or would otherwise be burned), this minion burns a blood or life instead. If he or she cannot, he or she is burned. A minion may have only one Ilomba.

cards.name: Ilonka (G7)
cards.text: Independent: Once each turn, if Ilonka is ready after a successful bleed against you, she can look at the acting minion's controller's hand, then she can discard 1 card at random from it.

cards.name: Ilse (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat. Torrance Circle: Sterile.

cards.name: Ilyana Ravidovich (G3)
cards.text: Camarilla: You get 2 additional votes in any referendum to call a blood hunt on Ilyana. Once each action, Ilyana may burn 1 blood to get +1 intercept.

cards.name: Imanna (G6)
cards.title: 1 vote
cards.text: Independent. 1 vote (titled): Imanna gets +1 vote in referendums she calls. Blood cursed.

cards.name: Immaculate Vitae
cards.text:
Only usable when a vampire controlled by another Methuselah successfully hunts.
[qui] Put this card on that vampire; that vampire cannot block this reacting vampire. Burn this card if that vampire goes into torpor.
[QUI] As above, but the acting vampire does not gain blood from the current hunting action.

cards.name: Immense Size
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined. A vampire can play only one Immense Size each combat.
[vic] The opposing minion cannot play grapple cards (this includes cards named /Immortal Grapple/ and /Mighty Grapple/) this combat.
[VIC] As above, with 1 optional press.

cards.name: Immortal Grapple
cards.text:
Grapple. Only usable at close range before strikes are chosen. A vampire can play only one Immortal Grapple each round.
[pot] Strikes that are not hand strikes cannot be used this round (by either combatant).
[POT] As above, with 1 optional press. If another round of combat occurs, that round is at close range (skip the determine range step for that round).

cards.name: Imogen (G2)
cards.title: Archbishop
cards.text: Sabbat Archbishop of Miami: Imogen can exchange one random card from the hand of your prey or predator for one library card from that Methuselah's ash heap as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Imperator
cards.text:
Title.
Choose a Camarilla vampire with capacity 8 or more. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire to represent the unique Camarilla title of Imperator (worth 3 votes). This vampire may play a Blood Hunt card from your hand or ash heap as a prince. This vampire gets 3 additional votes in blood hunt referendums.

cards.name: Imperial Decree
cards.text:
Requires a ready justicar or Inner Circle member. +1 stealth action.
Put this card in play. As a Ⓓ action, any Camarilla vampire may enter combat with any Non-Camarilla vampire controlled by another Methuselah. Any vampire may burn this card as a Ⓓ action; Non-Camarilla vampires get -1 stealth when attempting that action.

cards.name: Imposing Phantasm
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined. A vampire can play only one Imposing Phantasm each combat.
[chi] This vampire gets +1 strength this combat. After combat ends, if the opposing minion is ready, the opposing minion gains blood or life equal to the amount they lost to damage this combat.
[CHI] As above, with 1 additional strike (limited) this round.

cards.name: Imprison
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined.
For the remainder of combat, the opposing monster cannot maneuver or press to continue, and strikes other than strikes to end combat cost the opposing monster an additional blood or life.
cards.flavor:
Wherever a man is against his will, that to him is a prison.
Epictetus

cards.name: Improvised Flamethrower
cards.text:
Weapon.
Strike: 2R aggravated damage, only usable once per combat. If the opposing minion inflicts any damage on this minion at long range (even if it is prevented), this weapon is burned and the bearer takes 2 aggravated (non-strike) damage.
cards.flavor:
He just exploded. Never seen anything like it without a Tremere around.
Roger MacEllen, Lasombra Ductus

cards.name: Improvised Tactics
cards.text:
Requires a ready anarch. Only usable before range is determined on the first round. A minion can play only 1 Improvised Tactics each combat.
[aus] During the press step each round, draw one card. Discard down to your hand size afterward.
[pot] At long range, each round, this minion may strike for 2R damage each strike.
[pro] Once each round, this vampire may burn 1 blood to get one maneuver.

cards.name: Impundulu
cards.text:
Unique demon with 1 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Impundulu has flight [FLIGHT], gets one optional maneuver each combat, and may strike: 1R damage. He may steal 1 blood or life from a minion as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: In Memory of the Two Lands
cards.printedName: In Memory of the Two Lands
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play with 1 counter for each Follower of Set and mummy you control. During an action, you can burn 1 counter from this card to give a mummy you control +1 bleed or +1 strength. Burn this card if it has no counters.

cards.name: Inbase Discotek, Frankfurt
cards.text:
Master: unique location.
Lock to give a vampire who successfully hunts an additional blood from the blood bank. (Ignore excess blood.)
cards.flavor:
Come to me now, you delicate Graces...
Sappho

cards.name: Inceptor
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card on a vampire of capacity 1, and put three cards from your hand, ash heap or library on this card, face up but out of play. This vampire may play other copies of these cards as if he or she had the Discipline required (if any) at superior.

cards.name: Inconnu Tutelage
cards.text:
Inconnu.
A Methuselah may spend four transfers and remove a vampire in his or her uncontrolled region from the game to search for any card in his or her library and put it in his or her hand (discarding and shuffling afterward).

cards.name: Increased Strength
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[pot] For the remainder of combat, all damaging strikes that require Potence [pot] made by this vampire inflict +1 damage.
[POT] As above, but those strikes inflict +2 damage.

cards.name: Incriminating Videotape
cards.text:
Equipment.
Choose a minion your prey controls. The chosen minion cannot block the minion with this equipment.

cards.name: Indira (G6)
cards.text: Anarch.

cards.name: Indomitability
cards.text:
[for] Prevent 1 damage.
[FOR] Press, or prevent 1 damage with 1 optional press.

cards.name: Inês Tristão (G6)
cards.title: Prince
cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Rio de Janeiro.

cards.name: Inevitability of the Void
cards.text:
Only usable during a bleed action.
[aus][nec] +1 bleed (limited).
[AUS][NEC] +1 bleed for every 10 cards in the ash heap of the target Methuselah (limited).

cards.name: Inez "Nurse216" Villagrande (G4)
cards.text: When Inez enters play, you may search your library (shuffle afterward) or hand for a power that requires innocence and put it on her.

cards.name: Infamous Insurgent
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card on a Red List Anarch vampire. This vampire is infernal, Bahari, and gets +2 votes. During this vampire's minion phase, their controller can unlock a ready Anarch they control.

cards.name: Infamous Warlock
cards.text:
Master.
Put this card on a Tremere antitribu with a title. The vampire with this card cannot cast votes or ballots.
cards.flavor:
I owe allegiance to the race of those Who from the dark aspire to clarity.
Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

cards.name: Infection
cards.text:
[for] Prevent all damage from the opponent's strikes this round.
[thn] Prevent all damage to a ghoul (ally or retainer) in combat. Usable by a vampire not involved in the combat.
[THN] Only usable at the end of a round in which this vampire successfully inflicted damage on the opposing vampire. Put this card on the opposing vampire. The vampire with this card cannot block the vampire playing this card.

cards.name: Infernal Familiar
cards.text:
Demon with 2 life.
[tha] The vampire with this retainer can play a card that requires a Discipline he or she does not have as if he or she had the basic level of that Discipline; if he or she does so, place an investment counter on the Infernal Familiar. If the number of investment counters on the Familiar is greater than this vampire's capacity, burn this vampire.

cards.name: Infernal Pact
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card on a Tremere antitribu you control and choose a Discipline. The vampire with this card can play cards that require that Discipline as though he or she has the superior version of that Discipline.

cards.name: Infernal Pursuit
cards.text:
[cel] Press.
[CEL] For the remainder of the combat, each time you replace a card (including when you draw to replace this card), draw an additional card and discard down to your hand size.
cards.flavor:
Hunt. Hunt again.
If you do not find it, you will die.
Robert Penn Warren, "Treasure Hunt"

cards.name: Infernal Servitor
cards.text:
Unique demon with 2 life. 1 strength, 3 bleed. Requires an infernal vampire.
[dai] Infernal Servitor can perform actions the turn it is recruited. Remove it from the game if you control no infernal vampires, or after it performs a successful action.
[DAI] As above, and Infernal Servitor can play cards requiring basic Daimoinon [dai] and/or basic Obfuscate [obf] as a vampire.

cards.name: Inflict
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined.
For the remainder of combat, the amount of damage inflicted on this imbued by hand strikes, melee weapon strikes, or retainers is also inflicted on the striking minion or damage-dealing retainer, even if this imbued prevents the damage.

cards.name: Informant
cards.text:
Mortal with 1 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
The Informant cannot act or block. During your unlock phase, any Methuselah who controls a ready Ishtarri may look at your hand. During your discard phase, your predator takes control of the Informant.

cards.name: Information Highway
cards.text:
Unique location.
+2 transfers.

cards.name: Information Network
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Lock to give a Nosferatu antitribu you control +1 intercept.
cards.flavor:
Knowledge is of two kinds: we know a subject ourselves, or we know where we can find information upon it.
Samuel Johnson, in James Boswell's "The Life of Samuel Johnson, LL.D."

cards.name: Ingram Frizer (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat. Black Hand.

cards.name: Ingrid Rossler (G2)
cards.title: Prince
cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Geneva: If Ingrid is ready at the start of your influence phase, you get +2 transfers.

cards.name: Ingrid Russo (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Iniko, The Black Lion (G4)
cards.text: Laibon: +1 stealth.

cards.name: Inner Essence
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined. A vampire can play only one Inner Essence each combat.
[vic] Once this combat, this vampire can reduce the cost of a combat card they play by 1 blood.
[VIC] As above, and this vampire gains 1 blood.

cards.name: Innocent Bystander
cards.text:
Only usable when this acting vampire successfully bleeds a Methuselah.
Remove the top card of that Methuselah's crypt from the game.

cards.name: Inquisition
cards.text:
Requires a ready Sabbat vampire. +1 stealth action.
Ⓓ Choose one or more bishops. Each of the chosen bishops loses his or her title and takes 2 unpreventable damage. The controllers of the chosen bishops may attempt to block in addition to the normally eligible blockers.

cards.name: Inscription
cards.text:
Equipment.
[tha] Put this equipment on a ready vampire and put a card that requires Blood Sorcery [tha] from your hand on it (face up, out of play; this acting vampire pays the cost of that card). The vampire with this equipment can burn this equipment to use the basic Blood Sorcery ability of that card.
[THA] As above, but the vampire can use the superior Blood Sorcery [THA] ability of the card.

cards.name: Inside Dirt
cards.text: Ⓓ Burn the Edge to burn 3 blood from a vampire controlled by another Methuselah, or to burn 3 pool from your prey.

cards.name: Inspire
cards.text:
[ACTION] [1 CONVICTION] +1 stealth action.
Add a counter to an imbued in your uncontrolled region or move the conviction [1 CONVICTION] you paid for this action from your ash heap to any imbued in play.
cards.flavor:
There's faith and there's blind faith, son. Never get 'em mixed up.
Father St. George, Judge

cards.name: Inspire Greatness
cards.text:
Only usable by a ready vampire other than the acting minion.
[pot][pre] The acting ally or younger vampire gets +1 strength during this action.
[POT][PRE] The acting ally or younger vampire gets +2 strength during this action.

cards.name: Instability
cards.text:
Master.
Only usable if your prey controls the Edge or the Edge is uncontrolled. Your prey may take the Edge if it is uncontrolled. You gain 2 pool. Only one Instability may be played each turn.
cards.flavor:
A wise man gets more use from his enemies than a fool from his friends.
Baltasar Gracian

cards.name: Instantaneous Transformation
cards.text:
[cel][pro] +1 stealth.
[CEL][PRO] Only usable after resolution of a successful action. Unlock this vampire. A vampire can play only one Instantaneous Transformation at superior each turn.

cards.name: Instinctive Reaction
cards.text:
Only usable if a minion controlled by your predator is acting.
[ani] +1 intercept.
[ANI] As above, with 1 optional maneuver during the resulting combat if this vampire blocks.
cards.flavor: Beckett had long since learned to trust his instincts. Sharp as they were, augmented by his undead abilities, they often warned him of dangers that even his night-vision and heightened senses were unable to detect.

cards.name: Institution Hunting Ground
cards.text:
Unique location. Hunting ground.
During your unlock phase, a ready vampire you control can gain 1 blood. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground each turn.
cards.flavor:
Chasing an errant swarm of bees is nothing to following a naked lunatic, when the fit of escaping is upon him!
Bram Stoker, "Dracula"

cards.name: Insurance Scam
cards.text:
Master.
Put this card in play. During your turn, you may lock this card and burn X locations you control to gain X pool.
cards.flavor:
I would rather be ashes than dust! I would rather that my spark should burn out in a brilliant blaze than it should be stifled by dry-rot.
Jack London

cards.name: Internal Recursion
cards.text:
Only usable if this vampire blocks, before block resolution.
[pre] During the resulting combat, this vampire can strike: combat ends. If they do so and the acting minion is an ally or younger vampire, unlock this blocking vampire before combat ends.
[tem] This blocking vampire sets the range for the first round of the resulting combat.
[TEM] The acting minion does not unlock during their next unlock phase.

cards.name: Intimidation
cards.text:
[pre] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[PRE] Ⓓ Bleed with +2 bleed.
cards.flavor:
They are weak and easily cowed. Show your fangs and they will run.
Gerard, Ventrue antitribu

cards.name: Intisar (G2)
cards.text: Independent: If Intisar is ready and you have the Edge during your unlock phase, you can give another Methuselah 1 pool to lock a minion they control.

cards.name: Into the Fire
cards.text:
Master. Trifle.
Choose a ready non-Sabbat vampire you control. That vampire becomes Sabbat. (His or her clan is not affected.)
cards.flavor:
You're either with me or against me. You really don't want to be against me.
Desiree Traville, Brujah antitribu

cards.name: Into Thin Air
cards.text:
Do not replace until your unlock phase.
[obf] +1 stealth. Once this action, this vampire may burn 1 blood to give an ally or younger vampire -1 intercept. Into Thin Air and Lost in Crowds cannot both be played on the same action.
[OBF] As above, but for +2 stealth.

cards.name: Inveraray, Scotland
cards.text:
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
The vampire with this location may move 1 blood to this card as an action; no more than 3 blood may be put on this card. This vampire gets +X bleed, where X is the amount of blood on this card.

cards.name: Investiture
cards.text:
Requires a cardinal or regent. Title.
In this referendum, each ready cardinal gets one additional vote. Choose a Sabbat vampire. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire to represent the Sabbat title of priscus. Camarilla vampires cannot cast votes or ballots during this referendum.

cards.name: Invigorate
cards.text:
Requires an Anarch.
[ani] This Anarch gets +1 strength this action.
[dom] This Anarch cannot be blocked by allies this action.
[pro] This Anarch's hand strikes are aggravated this action.

cards.name: Invitation Accepted
cards.text: Successful referendum means this card is put in play and each Follower of Set can choose to become Camarilla. As any Follower of Set enters play, they can choose to become Camarilla.

cards.name: Invoke Poison Glands
cards.text:
[abo] [REFLEX] Cancel a frenzy card played on this vampire as it is played.
[abo] Strike: hand strike at +1 damage.
[ABO] Strike: burn the opposing animal or mortal, or strike: hand strike at +X damage, where X is the number of Orun on this vampire.

cards.name: Invoking the Beast
cards.text:

The leopard's coat is beautiful, but his heart is evil.
Baluba proverb

cards.name: Legendary Vampire
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card on a vampire with capacity 7 or more who entered your ready region during your last influence phase. This vampire gets +2 bleed and +2 votes. Any vampire can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

cards.name: Legion
cards.text:
Requires a ready vampire with capacity above 7. +1 stealth action.
Put this card on this acting vampire. This non-Sterile vampire can put a Master Discipline card from your hand or ash heap in play to represent a fledgling with 1 level of that Discipline and discard the rest of your hand as a +2 stealth action. The fledgling is a 1-capacity, non-unique vampire of the same clan and sect as this vampire. The fledgling cannot act or block or play cards if this vampire is not ready.

cards.name: Legwork
cards.text:
Do not replace until your next unlock phase.
+1 intercept. Not usable by a vampire with more than 0 intercept.

cards.name: Leila Monroe (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: Leila can change the sect of an Anarch with no blood to Sabbat as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Len Konopka (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat: If Len is ready at the start of your influence phase, you get +1 transfer. Black Hand.

cards.name: Lena Rowe (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Lena cannot receive any title.

cards.name: Lenelle, Mambo of Birmingham (G6)
cards.text: Independent: Lenelle can exchange a card from your hand for a library card in your ash heap as a +1 stealth action that costs 1 blood.

cards.name: Lenny Burkhead (G6)
cards.title: Primogen
cards.text: Camarilla primogen: +1 bleed.

cards.name: Leo Washington (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: An older vampire opposing Leo gets an optional maneuver on the first round of combat.

cards.name: Leon (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Gangrel antitribu get -1 intercept when attempting to block Leon.

cards.name: Leonardo, Mortician
cards.text:
Unique mortal with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Leonardo can add 1 blood to a ready vampire as a +1 stealth action.
cards.flavor:
Unnoticed in the house
Of Hades, too, you'll wander
Flittering after faded corpses.
Sappho

cards.name: Lernean (G4)
cards.title: Cardinal
cards.text: Sabbat cardinal: Once each round, Lernean may burn 1 blood to get an additional strike (limited).

cards.name: Lesser Boon
cards.text:
Master: out-of-turn. Boon.
Only usable when a minion you control would successfully block. The action resolves as if unblocked instead. Put this card on the acting minion. This minion cannot block your minions. Burn this card if you block this minion again, or when this minion's controller has less than 6 pool.

cards.name: Lessons in the Steel
cards.text:
[aus][for] Only usable when damage is successfully inflicted on this vampire. Look at the opposing minion's controller's hand, and this vampire gets an optional press this round. A vampire can play only one Lessons in the Steel each round.
[AUS][FOR] As above, and that Methuselah discards a card of your choice.
cards.flavor:
Knowledge by suffering entereth,
And life is perfected by death.
Elizabeth Barrett Browning, "A Vision of Poets", Conclusion

cards.name: Letter from Vienna
cards.text:
Master.
Lock all ready Tremere.
cards.flavor: The rulers of the Tremere clan, the Circle of Seven, reside in their chantry in Vienna. All Tremere obey the decrees of the Circle of Seven without question.

cards.name: Leumeah (G6)
cards.title: Baron
cards.text: Anarch Baron of Canberra.

cards.name: Leverage
cards.text:
Only usable during a bleed action.
Burn the Edge to get +1 bleed that does not count against the limit. You cannot gain the Edge this action. If you would get the Edge, it is burned instead.
cards.flavor:
It is a mistake to try to look too far ahead. The chain of destiny can only be grasped one link at a time.
Sir Winston Churchill

cards.name: Lextalionis
cards.text: Choose a Methuselah who has received a victory point since your last turn. Successful referendum means the Methuselah must immediately lock all of his or her minions; the minions do not unlock as normal during the Methuselah's next unlock phase.

cards.name: Lia Milliner (G3)
cards.text: Independent.

cards.name: Libertas
cards.text:
Requires an Anarch.
Put this card on an Anarch. Allies cannot block this Anarch. Cards requiring Dominate [dom] or Presence [pre] cost other minions +1 blood while this Anarch is acting, attempting to block or in combat.

cards.name: Liberty Club Intrigue
cards.text:
Requires a ready titled non-Anarch vampire. +1 stealth action.
Choose up to two Anarch vampires with capacities of 5 or less. Each chosen vampire is locked and does not unlock as normal on his or her next unlock phase.

cards.name: Library Hunting Ground
cards.text:
Unique location. Hunting ground.
During your unlock phase, a ready vampire you control can gain 1 blood. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground each turn.

cards.name: Life Boon
cards.text:
Out-of-turn. Boon.
Give pool to a Methuselah with no pool to keep them in the game, and put this card in play. During each of their unlock phases, you can steal 1 pool from that Methuselah. You gain any victory point gained by that Methuselah instead of them, until you are being ousted or until you have gained 1 victory point from this card. Burn this card after you have gained 1 victory point from this card.

cards.name: Life in the City
cards.text:
Trifle.
Add 1 blood to a ready vampire.
cards.flavor:
I steer clear of paying customers who might be missed, but solos are fair game. The black marketers think I'm doing a little slave trade on the side.
Ingrid Galt, Anarch

cards.name: Lifeless Tongues
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Ⓓ Remove a vampire in any Methuselah's ash heap from the game and put this card in play under the control of that Methuselah. During this acting vampire's unlock phase, this acting vampire's controller can look at the hand of this Methuselah. Any minion can burn this card as a +1 stealth action.
[NEC] As above, but during any unlock phase.

cards.name: Light Intensifying Goggles
cards.text:
Electronic.
The bearer gets 1 optional maneuver during the first round of combat. You can move any aim card the bearer uses to this card, face up and out of play (even if it is canceled). The bearer can play an aim card on this equipment as if from your hand; it is then removed from the game.

cards.name: Lightning Reflexes
cards.text:
[cel] Additional strike (limited).
[CEL] Burn X blood to get X additional strikes (limited).
cards.flavor:
Celerity is never more admired
Than by the negligent.
William Shakespeare, "Antony & Cleopatra", act III, scene 7

cards.name: Lika, The Purger (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Lilith's Blessing
cards.text:
Master.
Put this card in play. As a master phase action, you may lock this card to search your library for a master: Discipline card and choose a ready non-Bahari vampire you control who has no blood. That vampire gains the Discipline card (if any) and 3 blood and becomes Bahari.

cards.name: Lille Haake (G3)

cards.text:

Burn 7 cards from the top of your library to gain 3 pool.
cards.flavor:
How little you know about the age you live in if you think that honey is sweeter than cash in hand.
Ovid

+1 stealth action.
This acting Samedi and all younger Samedi in your uncontrolled region each gain a blood from the bank.
cards.flavor:
Dark hills at evening in the west,
Where sunset hovers like a sound
Of golden horns that sang to rest
Old bones of warriors under ground...
Edwin Arlington Robinson, "The Dark Hills"

cards.name: Little Tailor of Prague (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Allies and retainers requiring a Tzimisce or Vicissitude [vic] cost the Tailor -1 blood or pool. +1 bleed.

cards.text:
Unique melee weapon.
Strength damage each strike. Imbued inflict +X damage each strike with this weapon. Using Cleave with this weapon will not burn this weapon.
cards.flavor:
If you can't kill the damn thing, stop wasting your time.
Lupe "Cabbie22" Droin, Defender

cards.text: Liz doesn't gain a conviction [1 CONVICTION] as normal when entering play.

cards.name: Lizette (G4)

cards.text:
This action is at +1 stealth if it is undirected.
Put this card on any minion. Other Methuselahs' actions targeting this minion cost monsters an additional blood or life. If this minion is a monster, he or she burns a blood or life when he or she attempts an action or a block. This minion may burn this card as an action. A minion can have only one Lock.

cards.name: Lodin (Olaf Holte) (G5)

cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Chicago: Once each combat, Lodin can prevent 1 damage from an opposing minion's strike.

cards.name: Loki's Gift
cards.text:
+1 stealth hunt action.
[pro] Hunt, and put this card on this vampire. This vampire can burn this card and 1 blood to get +1 stealth. A vampire can have only one Loki's Gift.
[PRO] Ⓓ As above, and burn 1 blood from any vampire. This vampire can burn this card as above, or can burn it during the polling step of any referendum to get +2 votes.

cards.name: Lolita (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Lolita Houston (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: London Evening Star, Tabloid Newspaper
cards.text:
Master: unique location.
Lock to give any minion +1 intercept for the current action.
cards.flavor:
He... remarked that the smuts in London were not so bad as they used to be when he was a student there.
Bram Stoker, "Dracula"

cards.name: Loner
cards.text:
Master: archetype.
Put this card on a vampire you control. During your influence phase, if this vampire successfully performed an action this turn and none of your other minions attempted any actions this turn, he or she gains 1 blood from the blood bank, if he or she is ready. A vampire can have only one archetype.

cards.name: Loonar (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.text:
Requires an Anarch. Only usable as the action is announced. If this action is blocked, apply the following effect before block resolution:
[dem] Lock a younger non-blocking vampire controlled by the blocking minion's controller.
[tha] Move 2 blood from a non-blocking vampire controlled by the blocking minion's controller to this vampire.
[vic] Damage from this vampire's hand strikes is aggravated during the resulting combat.

cards.text: Sabbat. Black Hand: Frenzy cards played on Aaron cost an additional blood or pool.

cards.text: Camarilla: You can search your library for another copy of an action card Ephraim plays after it is played and move that copy to your ash heap (shuffle afterward). If the action succeeds, move the card to your hand.

cards.name: Lord Fianna (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla: Allies cannot block Lord Fianna. Red List. +1 stealth.

cards.name: Lord Leopold Valdemar (G5)
cards.title: Priscus
cards.text: Sabbat priscus: Leopold can strike, ranged: steal 2 blood or life (becoming blood).

cards.name: Lord of Serenity
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[for] Rescue up to two vampires from torpor. Vampires can ignore the normal prey, predator or target restrictions for blocking this action.
[obe] Put this card on this vampire. During your unlock phase, this vampire can gain 1 blood. Vampires can burn this card as a Ⓓ action.
[OBE] As [obe] above, but this vampire can gain 2 blood.

cards.name: Lord Tremere (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla: Cards requiring Blood Sorcery [tha] cost Lord Tremere 1 fewer blood. During your minion phase, you can lock or unlock another ready Tremere or Tremere antitribu. +2 bleed. +1 intercept.

cards.name: Lord Vauxhall (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Lorrie Dunsirn (G4)
cards.text: Independent: Lorrie cannot play reaction cards, have equipment or retainers, maneuver to long, or press to end. She gets an additional strike (limited) each round and a press each combat. Non-hunt actions cost her an additional pool. +1 strength. Scarce. Sterile.

cards.name: Loss
cards.text:
[qui] Ⓓ Burn an equipment or location on a minion controlled by your predator or prey.
[QUI] Ⓓ Bleed with +2 bleed.

cards.name: Lost in Crowds
cards.text:
[obf] +1 stealth. Lost in Crowds and cards named /Into Thin Air/ cannot both be played during the same action.
[OBF] As above, but for +2 stealth.
cards.flavor:
...he knows a frightful fiend
Doth close behind him tread.
Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

cards.name: Lost in Translation
cards.text:
Only usable when an ally or younger vampire is bleeding you, after blocks are declined.
Lock this reacting vampire. Choose another Methuselah other than the acting minion's controller. The acting minion is now bleeding the chosen Methuselah. Only one Lost in Translation may be played each action.

cards.name: Louhi (G4)
cards.title: Cardinal
cards.text: Sabbat cardinal: Once each turn, if Louhi is ready, she can burn 1 blood to cancel an action card as it is played by a vampire controlled by your predator (the acting minion does not lock).

cards.name: Louis de Maisonneuve (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.text:
Anarch.

cards.name: Loving Agony
cards.text:
Only usable at close range.
[ani] Strike: hand strike at +1 damage.
[val] Strike: combat ends, and inflict 1 unpreventable damage on the opposing minion after combat ends.
[VAL] As [val] above, and this vampire can burn 1 blood to unlock before combat ends.

cards.name: Loyal Street Gang
cards.text: Mortal with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
cards.flavor:
These are the hired bravos who defend
The tyrant's throne -- the bullies of his fear.
Percy Bysshe Shelley, "Queen Mab"

cards.name: Loyalist
cards.text:
Only usable during a referendum. Usable by a locked vampire.
This vampire gains 3 votes against the referendum. If the acting vampire is Sabbat and the referendum fails, move up to 2 blood from the acting vampire to this vampire.
cards.flavor:
Old-fashioned Loyalists don't last all that long, even when they've got your potential for power.
Andrew Emory, Lasombra bishop

cards.name: Loyiso, The Ruthless (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Luciano Carvalho (G7)

cards.name: Lucina (G3)

cards.title: Justicar
cards.text: Camarilla Ventrue Justicar: During your master phase, Lucinde can burn 1 blood to choose a vampire; this turn, Camarilla vampires you control can enter combat with the chosen vampire as a Ⓓ action. +1 bleed.

cards.text:
Sabbat: During an action Lucita performs, she can burn 2 blood to cancel a reaction card as it is played by a vampire with capacity 5 or less, and its cost is not paid.

cards.text: If Lupe has a vehicle, once each action she may burn a conviction [1 CONVICTION] to get +1 stealth or +1 intercept.

Master. Do not replace until your influence phase.
Each Methuselah (including you) discards 5 cards of his or her choice, then draws back up to his or her hand size. Only one Lupine Assault may be played in a game.

cards.text:

cards.name: MacAlister Marshall (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla: Other Tremere get +1 intercept during actions directed at MacAlister.

cards.flavor:
Show me a sane man and I will cure him for you.
Carl Gustav Jung

Unique Master.

cards.flavor:
Would you, could you, in the rain?
I would not, could not, in the rain.
Not in the dark; not on a train...
Dr. Seuss, "Green Eggs and Ham"

cards.name: Madrigal
cards.text:
