[cel][pre] Choose a vampire who has cast votes or ballots in this referendum. The chosen vampire is locked and abstains (this cancels the chosen vampire's votes and ballots).
[CEL][PRE] As above, and the chosen vampire burns 1 blood.

cards.name: Scapelli, The Family "Mechanic"
cards.text:
Unique mortal with 3 life. 0 strength, 1 bleed.
Scapelli may strike for 2R damage. Once each combat, Scapelli may press to continue combat.

cards.name: Scarlet Carson O'Toole (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Scarlet Lore
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Move a minion card from your ash heap to the top of your library.
[myt] Search your library for a minion card (shuffle afterward), reveal it, and move it to the top of your library.
[MYT] As [myt] above, with an additional +1 stealth.

cards.name: Scattershot
cards.text:
Ammo.
Only usable before resolution of a gun's strike. This gun inflicts +2 damage at close range and -2 damage at long range each strike for the remainder of this combat. No more than one ammo card can be used on a gun each combat.
cards.flavor: Tara fired once, blindly, over the table and into the doorway. Her objective wasn't actually to hit anyone (though she certainly wouldn't mind), but to keep the thin-bloods back for another moment.

cards.name: SchreckNET
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Unique.
If this Nosferatu's capacity is 6 or more, he or she unlocks. Put this card in play. Whenever a referendum succeeds, you may lock this card to look at any Methuselah's hand.

cards.name: Schuyler (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: If Schuyler is blocked, your prey can move a library card from their ash heap to the top of their library before block resolution.

cards.name: Scobax
cards.text:
[pre] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[str] The acting minion gets -1 stealth. [str] is not a Discipline.
[STR] As [str] above, and the action fails unless the acting minion burns 1 blood or life.

cards.name: Scorn of Adonis
cards.text:
Only usable during the polling step of a political action.
Methuselahs casting (including controlling a minion casting) votes or ballots against the referendum burn 1 pool once results are tallied.

cards.name: Scorpion Sting
cards.text:
[ani] Strike: hand strike at +1 damage.
[ANI] As above, and this strike cannot be dodged.

cards.name: Scorpion's Touch
cards.text:
[qui] Strike: hand strike or use a melee weapon strike and put this card on the opposing minion. The attached minion gets -1 strength (this does not affect the current strike resolution). Any vampire can burn this card as a +1 stealth action. A minion can have only one Scorpion's Touch.
[QUI] As above, and the attached minion burns 1 blood or life during their unlock phase.

cards.name: Scourge
cards.text:
Requires a titled vampire.
Choose a vampire of the same sect. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire and unlock this acting vampire. The vampire with this card may enter combat with a vampire with capacity 4 or less or with an ally as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Scourge of Alecto
cards.text:
Frenzy. Only usable against a vampire or werewolf.
[cel][pre] Strike: X-2 ranged damage, where X is this vampire's capacity minus the target's capacity or cost. If more than 4 damage is inflicted with this strike, ignore the excess.
[CEL][PRE] As above, with an optional maneuver.

cards.name: Scourge of the Enochians
cards.text: During your discard phase, you can burn a vampire with capacity 2 or less, and your predator takes control of this card (even if you do not burn a vampire).

cards.name: Scout Youngwood (G6)
cards.title: 2 votes
cards.text: Independent. 2 votes (titled): During your unlock phase, Scout can burn 2 blood to lock an ally or younger vampire controlled by your prey. Reaction cards cost her +1 blood.

cards.name: Scouting Mission
cards.text:
[dom] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[DOM] +1 stealth action. Add 2 blood to a younger vampire in your uncontrolled region.
cards.flavor:
It's amazing how trusting these Camarilla bastards can be.
Jimmy Dunn

cards.name: Screamer
cards.text:
Wraith with 1 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
You can burn this ally to give a minion controlled by your predator or prey -1 stealth. You can burn this ally as an action directed at an ally you control is announced to have it fail.

cards.name: Screw the Masquerade!
cards.text: Choose a Methuselah. Successful referendum means each Methuselah burns 1 pool and the chosen Methuselah burns an additional pool.
cards.flavor:
The Masquerade is unraveling as the mysticism of the mortals increases.
V.T., Vampire: The Masquerade

cards.name: Scrounging
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
Look at up to 3 cards from the top of your library and move up to 2 of them to your hand (shuffle and discard afterward).

cards.name: Scry the Hearthstone
cards.text:
Only usable during an action directed at you (or a card you control).
[tha] +1 intercept.
[vis] As [tha] above, with 1 optional maneuver during the resulting combat if this vampire blocks.
[VIS] Cancel an action card or action modifier card requiring Chimerstry [chi] or Obfuscate [obf] as it is played, and its cost is not paid.

cards.name: Scrying of Secrets
cards.text:
Only usable when this vampire successfully bleeds a Methuselah.
[aus] Look at the next 7 cards in that Methuselah's library.
[AUS] As above, and if any of those cards are action cards that can be used to bleed, that Methuselah discards your choice of one of those cards.

cards.name: Sculpt the Flesh
cards.text:
[pro] Strike: hand strike, aggravated.
[PRO] Strike: hand strike at +1 damage and put this card on the opposing minion. During their unlock phase, the attached minion burns 1 blood or life. Minions can burn this card as a +1 stealth action.

cards.name: Seal of Veddartha
cards.text:
Unique equipment.
Only usable by a vampire with capacity above 5. This vampire can bleed at +1 bleed as a Ⓓ action. During each of your unlock phases, put a counter on this card if it has 3 or fewer counters. The first 2 counters each grant this vampire one level of Dominate [dom]. The next 2 each grant this vampire one level of Fortitude [for]. Remove all counters from this card if another minion gains control of it.

cards.name: Sean Andrews (G4)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Sean Rycek (G4)
cards.text: Camarilla: Once each referendum, Sean may lock or burn a blood to gain 2 votes. He may burn a boon as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Seattle Committee
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Lock during your master phase to make a ready non-titled, non-Anarch vampire you control Anarch.

cards.name: Sebastian Marley (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla: +1 strength.

cards.name: Sébastien Goulet (G3 ADV)
cards.text:
Sabbat: Sébastien gets +1 stealth on recruit and employ actions.
[MERGED] He can steal an ally or retainer as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Sébastien Goulet (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat: Allies and retainers cost Sébastien 1 less blood or pool. Once each action, he can burn 1 blood to get +1 bleed.

cards.name: Second Sight
cards.text:
An imbued may burn only one Second Sight for the following effects each action.
Burn when a monster is acting to give this imbued +1 intercept for that action.
Burn when this imbued declares an action to give monsters -1 intercept for this action.

cards.name: Second Tradition: Domain
cards.text:
Requires a prince or justicar.
[REACTION] +2 intercept.
[REACTION] Only usable by a locked prince or justicar. This vampire burns 1 blood to unlock and attempt to block with +2 intercept, even if intercept is not yet needed.
cards.flavor: None may challenge thy word while in thy domain.

cards.name: Secret Horde
cards.text:
Master: investment.
Put this card in play and move 2X blood from the blood bank to this card. You may use a master phase action to move 1 blood from this card to your pool. Burn this card when it has no counters.

cards.name: Secret Passage
cards.text:
Master.
Put this card on a ready minion you control. If this minion is the target of a directed action while he or she is ready, you may burn this card to make the action fail. A minion can have only one Secret Passage.

cards.name: Secure Haven
cards.text:
Unique location. Haven.
Put this card on a minion you control. This minion cannot be the target of other Methuselahs' actions. Master cards targeting this minion cost 1 additional pool. Burn this card after this minion goes to torpor. A minion can have only one haven.

cards.name: Seduction
cards.text:
Only usable as the action is announced.
[dom] Choose a younger vampire. The chosen vampire cannot block this action.
[DOM] As above, but choose any vampire.
cards.flavor:
Letting go is the secret; giving up to me is the greatest pleasure of all...
Robbi Sommers, Lilith

cards.name: Seeds of Corruption
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[tha] Ⓓ Put this card on one of your prey's vampires. If the vampire is a Follower of Set, he or she burns 2 additional blood when attempting an action; otherwise, he or she burns 1 additional blood when attempting an action. The vampire's special abilities cannot be used. Any vampire(s) may burn this card with two +1 stealth actions.
[THA] As above, but the vampire burns 2 additional blood when attempting an action; Followers of Set burn 3 additional blood.

cards.name: Seeds of Terror
cards.text:
Only usable as the action is announced.
[obf] or [pre] Minions must burn 1 blood to attempt to block this action.
[OBF] or [PRE] As above, and choose a vampire. The chosen vampire cannot block this action.

cards.name: Sela (G2 ADV)
cards.title: Archbishop
cards.text: Advanced, Sabbat Archbishop of Rome: Sela gets +1 stealth on actions directed at a Methuselah who controls a ready bishop.

cards.name: Sela (G2)
cards.title: Bishop
cards.text: Sabbat bishop: If Sela becomes an archbishop, each ready bishop controlled by your prey burns 1 blood. +1 bleed.

cards.name: Selective Silence
cards.text:
Only usable during the first round of combat.
[qui] Maneuver.
[QUI] Only usable before range is determined. Burn 1 blood to set the range for this round.

cards.name: Selena (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat. Black Hand: Damage inflicted on Selena by a werewolf is aggravated.

cards.name: Selma the Repugnant (G1)
cards.title: Prince
cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Cleveland: Selma gets +1 intercept when attempting to block a Nosferatu vampire.

cards.name: Sengir Dagger
cards.text:
Unique melee weapon.
Strike: strength aggravated damage.

cards.name: Sennadurek (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat. Black Hand: Whenever a Methuselah loses the Edge when it is not your turn, Sennadurek unlocks, and you may look at that Methuselah's hand. Scarce.

cards.name: Sennuwy, The Promoter (G2)
cards.text: Independent.

cards.name: Sense Death
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[ani] Ⓓ Enter combat with a younger vampire.
[val] Ⓓ Enter combat with any minion. This acting vampire gets an optional press during this combat.
[VAL] As [val] above, and this acting vampire gets an optional maneuver during this combat.

cards.name: Sense the Savage Way
cards.text:
Requires a vampire with capacity 7 or more.
[ani] +1 intercept.
[ANI] Only usable by a locked vampire. This vampire unlocks and attempts to block.

cards.name: Sense the Sin
cards.text:
[aus] [REACTION] Only usable if a younger vampire is acting. +1 intercept.
[dai] [REACTION] +1 intercept, with an additional +1 intercept if the acting minion has any corruption counters.
[DAI] [ACTION MODIFIER] Only usable during a bleed action. +2 bleed (limited). Minions with any corruption counters get -1 intercept.

cards.name: Sense Vibrations
cards.text:
Master: trifle.
Put this card on a Laibon with Auspex [aus]. This Laibon with Auspex may lock this card during a referendum to get 1 additional vote. A vampire can have only one Sense Vibrations.

cards.name: Sense Vitality
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[for] This vampire gains 2 blood.
[val] Rescue a vampire from torpor.
[VAL] As [val] above, and the rescued vampire gains 1 blood.
cards.flavor:
It's not death if you refuse it. It is if you accept it.
James O'Barr, "The Crow"

cards.name: Sensory Deprivation
cards.text:
[chi] Ⓓ Burn a retainer or put this card on an ally. The attached minion does not unlock as normal. Burn this card after this acting vampire leaves the ready region.
[CHI] As above, but put this card on a vampire in play.

cards.name: Sensory Overload
cards.text:
[chi] Ⓓ Put this card on a ready minion; you still control this card. The attached minion cannot perform actions or block. Burn this card during their discard phase.
[CHI] As above, but burn this card during your unlock phase.
cards.flavor:
I have said that Danforth refused to tell me what final horror had made him scream out so insanely...
H.P. Lovecraft, "At the Mountains of Madness"

cards.name: Sentry Signal
cards.text:
[ani] or [tha] Only usable by a locked vampire. This vampire unlocks and attempts to block.
[ANI] or [THA] Reduce a bleed against you by 3.

cards.name: Seraph
cards.text:
Requires a Black Hand vampire.
Choose a non-Seraph Black Hand vampire with a capacity above 5. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire. That Black Hand vampire gains 2 blood and is a Seraph. Non-Sabbat vampires cannot cast votes or ballots in this referendum.

cards.name: Seraph's Second
cards.text:
Requires a ready Seraph. Only usable when a non-Seraph Black Hand vampire is acting, after resolution.
Unlock the acting Black Hand vampire. A Seraph may play only one Seraph's Second each turn.

cards.name: Seraphina (G7)
cards.text: Independent: Seraphina can add 2 blood or life to a minion you control as a +1 stealth action, not to exceed starting life.

cards.name: Seren Sukardi (G4)
cards.text: Independent: If in the previous round the range was long and no damage was successfully inflicted on Seren, he can strike: send the opposing vampire to torpor.

cards.name: Serenading the Kami
cards.text:
Only usable as the action is announced.
[tha] The acting vampire gets +1 strength this action.
[THA] As above, but with +2 strength.

cards.name: Serenna the White (G6)
cards.text: Independent: Once each turn, if Serenna is ready, she can burn 1 blood to reduce a bleed against you by 2. Scarce.

cards.name: Sergei Voshkov, The Eye (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla: If Sergei blocks, you can look at the acting Methuselah's hand, and he can burn 1 blood to discard 1 action card from it before block resolution. +1 intercept.

cards.name: Sergio Bueno (G6)
cards.title: Baron
cards.text: Anarch Baron of Santo Domingo: Minions with 1 or more of your corruption counters must burn 1 blood or life to attempt to block Sergio.

cards.name: Serhat Gunde, Combat Junkie (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat: Serhat gets 1 optional press each combat.

cards.name: Sermon of Caine
cards.text:
Master.
Move any amount of blood from one of your ready vampires to any combination of your other ready vampires.

cards.name: Serpent's Numbing Kiss
cards.text:
[pre][ser] Strike: combat ends.
[PRE][SER] As above, and if the range is close, this vampire burns 1 blood to put this card on the opposing minion and lock them. The attached minion does not unlock as normal. Burn this card during their unlock phase.

cards.name: Serpentis
cards.text:
Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Serpentis [ser] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Serpentis [SER].

cards.name: Servitor of Irad
cards.text:
Master.
Put this card on a ready vampire you control. After any Methuselah plays a Gehenna card, you may draw two additional cards from your library if this vampire is ready. Discard down to your hand size afterward. A vampire can have only one Servitor of Irad.
cards.flavor:
There will come a time when an Elder Darkness will stir deep below a city which has forgotten and will surprise the Elder, its children.
The Book of Nod

cards.name: Servius Marius Pustula (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: Each Methuselah gets +X hand size, where X is the number of ready vampires with capacity above 7 he or she controls.

cards.name: Set's Call
cards.text:
[ser] Only usable if this vampire blocks an employ retainer action, before block resolution. This action is successful (and the cost is paid), but this vampire steals the retainer and combat does not occur.
[SER] Only usable if this vampire blocks a recruit ally action, before block resolution. This action is successful (and the cost is paid), but this vampire steals the ally and combat does not occur.

cards.name: Set's Curse
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[ser] Ⓓ Burn an ally or retainer controlled by any Methuselah to put this card in play; it becomes an animal ally with 3 life, 2 strength and 0 bleed. This ally cannot play action cards and cannot have or use equipment or retainers.
[SER] As above, but burn a vampire with capacity 2 or less to put this card in play.

cards.name: Seterpenre (G5)
cards.text: Independent: As Seterpenre enters play, put up to four master Discipline cards on him from your hand, ash heap and/or library (shuffle afterward). Discipline cards do not affect his capacity.

cards.name: Sha-Ennu (G4)
cards.title: Regent
cards.text: Sabbat regent: Vampires with capacity 3 or less cannot block Sha-Ennu. +2 bleed.

cards.name: Shaal Fragment
cards.text:
Unique Nod fragment.
+2 hand size. Any vampire can steal this equipment as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Shackles of Enkidu
cards.text:
Unique equipment.
Before range is chosen in a round of combat, you may put the Shackles on any minion opposing the vampire with this card; you still controls this card, however. Combat ends. The Shackled minion does not unlock as normal during his or her unlock phases; he or she burns 2 blood during each of your unlock phases. Any minion may burn this card as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Shade
cards.text:
Demon with 2 life.
[obt] Shade inflicts 1 damage on the opposing minion each round of combat during normal strike resolution at close range.
[OBT] As above, but Shade has 3 life.
cards.flavor:
Yet even your darkest shade a canvas forms
Whereon my eye must multiply in swarms
Familiar looks of shapes no longer there.
Charles Baudelaire, "Obsession"

cards.name: Shadow Body
cards.text:
[obt] Strike: combat ends.
[OBT] As above, and if this vampire was blocked while performing a non-bleed non-political action, the action continues as if unblocked.
cards.flavor:
The awful shadow of some unseen Power
Floats, tho' unseen, amongst us.
Percy Bysshe Shelley, "Hymn to Intellectual Beauty"

cards.name: Shadow Boxing
cards.text:
[obf][pot] [COMBAT] Maneuver, only usable to get to close range, or press, only usable to continue combat.
[OBF][POT] [ACTION MODIFIER] Only usable after a combat resulting from a block. Not usable if the blocking minion is ready. This vampire burns 1 blood to continue the action as if unblocked.

cards.name: Shadow Cast
cards.text:
[obl] +1 stealth.
[OBL] Only usable after resolution of a successful directed action. Put this card on this vampire. During an action directed at the same Methuselah or same set of Methuselahs, this vampire can burn this card to get +1 stealth.

cards.name: Shadow Cloak
cards.text:
[obl] +1 stealth.
[OBL] Only usable after resolution of a successful action. Put this card on this vampire. Minions without Auspex [aus] cannot perform actions directed at this vampire. During your unlock phase, burn this card.

cards.name: Shadow Court Satyr
cards.text:
Changeling with 3 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
When the Satyr enters play, you can put a combat card from your hand on him. Once each combat, the Satyr can use the ability of that card as if played from your hand. If the card requires a vampire (e.g., costs blood or requires a Discipline), he can use it as a vampire with the basic level of 1 of the Discipline(s) (if any).

cards.name: Shadow Feint
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[cel][obf] This vampire gets first strike this round.
[CEL][OBF] As above, and this vampire's strikes cannot be dodged this round.

cards.name: Shadow of Taint
cards.text:
[dom] Ⓓ Move a card played by another Methuselah on an ally in your ready region to another ally.
[val] As [dom] above, or move a card played by another Methuselah on a vampire in your ready region to another minion on whom the card could be played. That minion cannot be a vampire older than the vampire with the card.
[VAL] As [val] above, and this action is at +1 stealth.

cards.name: Shadow of the Beast
cards.text:
[pro] Put this card on the acting vampire. The vampire with this card gets an optional maneuver each combat. A vampire may have only one Shadow of the Beast.
[PRO] As above, and this vampire gets an optional press each combat.

cards.name: Shadow of the Wolf
cards.text:
Only usable before range is chosen.
[pro] This vampire gets an additional strike (limited) with +1 strength during this round of combat.
[PRO] As above, with an optional press.

cards.name: Shadow Parasite
cards.text:
Only usable at long range.
[obt] Strike: 3R damage.
[OBT] Strike: 4R damage.

cards.name: Shadow Play
cards.text:
[obt] +1 stealth.
[OBT] +2 stealth.
cards.flavor:
You will close your eyes,
in order not to see, through the glass,
The evening shadows making faces.
Arthur Rimbaud, "A Dream for Winter"

cards.name: Shadow Sentinel
cards.text:
A vampire can play only one Shadow Sentinel between their unlock phases.
[obl] Only usable by a locked vampire. This vampire wakes.
[OBL] Usable by a locked vampire. Choose a locked wraith or zombie ally you control. The chosen ally wakes.

cards.name: Shadow Shift
cards.text:
[obl] Additional strike (limited).
[OBL] Maneuver.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.text:
[obt] Maneuver.
[OBT] Only usable before range is determined. Burn 2 blood to set the range for this round.

cards.name: Shadow Strike
cards.text:
[obt] Strike: strength ranged damage, with 1 optional maneuver.
[OBT] As above, with 1 optional press.

cards.name: Shadow Twin
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[obt] Ⓓ Inflict 1 unpreventable damage on any minion or retainer.
[OBT] As above, and put this card on the target minion; you still control this card. The attached minion gets -1 stealth. Burn this card during your unlock phase.

cards.name: Shadowed Eyes
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[aus][obt] Ⓓ Put this card on an ally or younger vampire. The attached minion gets -2 intercept and cannot perform directed actions or use ranged strikes. Any minion can burn this card as a +1 stealth action.
[AUS][OBT] As above, and the action to burn this card costs 1 additional blood or life.

cards.name: Shaggydog (G5)
cards.text: Sabbat. Black Hand: Shaggydog gets an optional press on the first round of combat.

cards.name: Shahara al-Rashwa (G6)
cards.text: Independent.

cards.name: Shahid (G4)
cards.text: Camarilla: You may lock Shahid during any other Methuselah's unlock phase to increase your hand size by X for the remainder of the turn, where X is the number of ready minions that Methuselah controls.

cards.name: Shakar
cards.text:
Master.
Put this card on a Black Hand vampire. This Black Hand vampire can enter combat with any younger non-Black Hand vampire as a Ⓓ action. A vampire can have only one Shakar.
cards.flavor:
Ar-Rashid said, A true assassin has no ego, which is well, for he receives no glory.
The Admonitions

cards.name: Shakar: the Hunt
cards.text:
Unique contract. Trifle. Requires a Black Hand vampire.
Put this card on a ready minion. Every Black Hand vampire is considered chosen for this contract. Any Black Hand vampire can enter combat with this minion as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. Burn this card if this minion is not ready.

cards.name: Shalmath (G6)
cards.text: Independent: Once each turn, Shalmath can unlock. He cannot use cards requiring Celerity [cel]. Scarce.

cards.name: Shaman
cards.text:
Unique mage with 2 life. Requires a ready Laibon.
This Laibon has +1 intercept. When acting, this Laibon can shuffle this retainer back into his owner's library to get +1 stealth.

cards.name: Shambling Hordes
cards.text:
Zombie with 3 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
[nec] After this ally enters play, remove an ally or vampire in your ash heap from the game or burn this ally. This ally gets +1 strength for each life it has. This ally can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action. It cannot gain life (instead, any life it would gain goes to the blood bank).
[NEC] As above, but this ally has 4 life.

cards.name: Shame
cards.text:
[COMBAT] [2 CONVICTION] Only usable before strikes are chosen.
Burn this card. The opposing monster takes an amount of damage equal to his or her strength, then combat ends. Not usable on an infernal minion, a vampire with capacity above 7, nor a vampire who has Memories of Mortality or Humanitas.
cards.flavor:
All honor's wounds are self-inflicted.
Andrew Carnegie

cards.name: Shane Grimald (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Shannon Price, the Whisperer (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Shanty Town Hunting Ground
cards.text:
Master: unique location. Hunting ground.
During your unlock phase, you may move 1 blood from the blood bank to a ready vampire you control. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground card each turn.
cards.flavor:
The desperate no longer care when death stalks their streets. Some think of it as a blessing.
Nigel the Shunned, Nosferatu antitribu

cards.name: Shape Mastery
cards.text:
[pro] [COMBAT] Cancel a combat card requiring Obtenebration [obt], Protean [pro] or Vicissitude [vic] as it is played, and its cost is not paid. The opposing minion cannot play that card again this action.
[PRO] [REACTION] As above, but cancel an action modifier card requiring any of those Disciplines.

cards.name: Shared Nightmare
cards.text:
[chi] Choose one or two allies or younger vampires controlled by your predator and/or prey. The chosen minions cannot block or cast votes or ballots this turn.
[CHI] As above, but choose three allies or younger vampires.

cards.name: Shared Strength
cards.text:
Only usable by a ready vampire not involved in combat.
[for] Choose a vampire in combat. For the remainder of combat, that vampire may play cards that require Fortitude [for] as if he or she has the basic level of Fortitude.
[FOR] As above, but the chosen vampire may play cards as if he or she has the superior level of Fortitude [FOR].

cards.name: Shasa Abu Badr (G4)
cards.text: Laibon: Shasa gets +1 bleed when bleeding with an action card that requires Presence [pre].

cards.name: Shatter the Gate
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires an infernal Baali with capacity 9 or more.
Put this card on this Baali; if this Baali has three copies of this card, burn these copies to give each other Methuselah who has no shattered counters 1 shattered counter with "During your unlock phase, burn 3 pool". A vampire with capacity 6 or more can burn the Edge to burn this card as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Shattered Mirror
cards.text:
Only usable if this vampire blocks an ally or younger vampire bleeding you, before block resolution.
[dem] Put this card on the acting minion, lock this vampire, and end the action. The attached minion gets -1 bleed. The attached vampire can burn this card as an action that costs 1 blood. A minion can have only one Shattered Mirror.
[DEM] As above, but do not lock this vampire.

cards.name: Shattering
cards.text:
Requires an Anarch.
[chi] +1 stealth action. Ⓓ Look at another Methuselah's hand and discard one card of your choice from it.
[dem] +2 stealth action. Burn an event. This action is undirected, no matter who controls the event.
[pro] Ⓓ Inflict 2 unpreventable damage on a ready minion.

cards.name: Shattering Blow
cards.text:
