But leechlike to their fainting country cling
Till they drop, blind in blood, without a blow.
Percy Shelley, "England in 1819"

cards.name: The Eldest Command Undeath
cards.text:
Requires a Laibon.
Choose a vampire controlled by your prey with capacity less than X. Successful referendum means that vampire is burned. This acting vampire cannot gain blood this action. Any blood he or she gains goes to the blood bank instead.

cards.name: The Embrace
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a non-sterile vampire.
Put this card in play. It becomes a 1-capacity non-unique vampire of the same clan and sect as the acting vampire, and must hunt this turn.

cards.name: The Erciyes Fragments
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Lock this card to move a library card from your prey's ash heap to this card, face down. You may look at that card at any time. You may play the card from the Fragments as if playing it from your hand (requirements and cost, if any, apply as normal). When that card is burned, remove it from the game instead. Only 1 card can be on this card at a time. Any vampire with a capacity above 4 can steal the Fragments (and any card on it) for his or her controller as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: The Eternal Mask
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[ser] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[SER] Put this card on this vampire and move a unique vampire from any ash heap to your ready region with any amount of blood from this acting vampire. The attached minion cannot perform actions, block, play reaction cards or cast votes or ballots. You can burn this card and the chosen vampire during any unlock phase.

cards.name: The Eternals of Sirius
cards.text: Gain 5 pool if you control a ready Follower of Set, or add 5 blood to a Follower of Set with capacity 9 or more in your uncontrolled region.

cards.name: The Final Nights
cards.text: Successful referendum means each vampire burns 1 blood. If this referendum fails, the acting vampire burns 1 blood.
cards.flavor:
The final nights are at hand.
Thetmes, Assamite

cards.name: The Fourth Cycle
cards.text:
Requires 2 or more Gehenna events in play.
After this card enters play, burn all Gehenna events and conviction cards, then send all vampires with capacity 3 or less to torpor. Gehenna events cannot be played.

cards.name: The Framing
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires an anarch.
Ⓓ Put this card on the acting anarch and choose a ready minion. If the anarch with this card is blocked, this card is burned. Then the blocking minion enters combat with the chosen minion instead of this anarch (or the action ends with no combat if that combat cannot occur).

cards.name: The Gate of Acheron
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Unique.
Put this card in play with 1 counter. During your unlock phase, add 1 counter to this card. During your prey's unlock phase, for each counter on this card, they burn 1 pool or remove a library card at random in their ash heap from the game. Hecata you control with capacity 4 or more can add 1 counter to this card as a +1 stealth action. Vampires can burn this card as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: The Ghouls of Plaza Morería
cards.text:
Unique ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
The Ghouls of Plaza Morería can strike: 1R damage. They get 1 optional maneuver each combat. They can burn 1 blood from a ready vampire and put 1 container counter on themselves as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. Any ready Assamite can burn X container counters from them to gain X blood as a +1 stealth action.

cards.name: The Grandest Trick
cards.text:
Only usable when an action is announced.
Vampires cannot block this minion. This acting vampire is treated as a mortal ally for the duration of the action (cannot spend or burn blood, cannot use Disciplines, will burn if reduced to 0 life, etc.). This vampire's blood represents his or her life while he or she is an ally. Only usable on an action that doesn't cost blood or require a vampire, clan or Discipline.

cards.name: The Guardian (G6)
cards.text: Camarilla: The Guardian cannot perform directed actions unless you control a ready unique older Nosferatu. The Guardian can lock after resolution of a successful bleed against you to enter combat with the acting minion.

cards.name: The Guruhi Are the Land
cards.text:
Only usable during a bleed, hunt, or equip action.
If this is a bleed action, this Guruhi gets +1 bleed (limited). If this is a hunt action, this Guruhi gains an additional blood if successful. If this is an equip action, this Guruhi unlocks if the action is successful.

cards.name: The Haunting
cards.text:
[dem] Ⓓ Put this card on a minion. The attached minion burns 1 blood or life during their unlock phase. Minions can burn this card as an action. A minion can have only one The Haunting.
[DEM] As above, and this is a +1 stealth action.

cards.name: The Horde (G6)
cards.text: Independent: During a bleed action, The Horde can lock to give another acting infernal minion +1 bleed. Infernal. Non-unique.

cards.name: The Hungry Coyote
cards.text:
Unique location.
Sabbat vampires you control get +1 hunt.

cards.name: The Hunt Club
cards.text:
Unique Master.
Put this card on any ready vampire. This vampire gets +1 stealth when attempting to commit diablerie. This vampire may not cast votes or ballots during a referendum to call a blood hunt on this vampire.

cards.name: The Jones
cards.text:
Only usable in combat with an ally or younger vampire.
[ser] Strike: dodge, with 1 optional press, only usable to end combat.
[SER] Cancel the opposing minion's strike card as it is played, and its cost is not paid (the minion chooses another strike). A vampire can play only one The Jones at superior each round.

cards.name: The Khabar: Community
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Assamites get +1 stealth when bleeding. Minions can burn this card as a Ⓓ action; Tremere get +1 stealth during that action.
cards.flavor: The enemy of my enemy is my friend; the friend of my enemy is my enemy.

cards.name: The Khabar: Honor
cards.text:
Only usable if this Assamite has been chosen for a contract on the opposing minion.
Strike: hand strike at +3 damage.

cards.name: The Kikiyaon (G4)
cards.text: Laibon: Once each combat, The Kikiyaon may burn a blood to get a maneuver. Flight [FLIGHT].

cards.name: The Kiss of Ra
cards.text:
Only usable when a vampire who does not have Fortitude [for] attempts to block this acting minion.
[for] The block attempt is canceled, the blocking vampire burns 2 blood, and the current action is ended (without combat).
[FOR] As above, and send the blocking vampire to torpor.

cards.name: The Knights
cards.text: Unique mortal with 2 life. 2 strength, 0 bleed.

cards.name: The Labyrinth
cards.text:
Unique location.
You can lock this card to give a Nosferatu you control +1 stealth.
cards.flavor:
But in vague ways, I most insanely yearn
To meet some lean, dwarfed, fetid, hairy thing
With loathsome skin and bulging eyes of rheum...
Francis Saltus, "A Courtesan's Whim"

cards.name: The Line
cards.text:
Unique location.
You can lock this location to reduce the cost of an action card a vampire you control plays by 1 blood (this location is not locked if that card is canceled as it is played). Vampires can steal this location as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: The Louvre, Paris
cards.text:
Unique location.
You can lock this location to lock a Toreador. If you control the Prince of Paris, you can lock this location to lock a minion. Minions can steal this location as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: The Malkavian Seven Miseries
cards.text:
Master.
Put this card in play. Any minion attempting a political action gets -1 stealth. This card may be burned by any minion who is not Tremere as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: The Marrakesh Codex
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Lock to look at and reorder the top 4 cards of your library. Any vampire may steal this card for his or her controller as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: The Mausoleum, Venice
cards.text:
Unique location.
Lock during the polling step of a political action to get +1 vote, with an additional +1 vote if the card named /Ventrue Headquarters/ is not in play.
cards.flavor:
...even the spectres have beads of sweat.
I come from the dead tomb;
I end up at this door through which
a gleam of light passes.
Victor Hugo, "I am made of shadow and marble"

cards.name: The Meddling of Semsith
cards.text: Choose another Methuselah. Successful referendum means this card is put in play. You get -1 hand size. The chosen Methuselah does not replace cards during any Methuselah's minion phase. Vampires can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

cards.name: The Medic (G5)
cards.text: Anarch: During your turn, you can burn the Edge to add 1 blood to an Anarch you control.

cards.name: The Missing Voice
cards.text:
[cel] Requires a vampire with capacity 5 or more. Vampires with capacity 4 or less get -1 intercept.
[mel] Allies and younger vampires get -1 intercept.
[MEL] +1 stealth.

cards.name: The Mithraeum, London
cards.text:
Unique location. Mithraic Mysteries.
If you do not control /Mithras/ during your influence phase, you can search your crypt for 1 copy of him, reveal it, and move it to your uncontrolled region (shuffle afterward). During your unlock phase, you can add 1 blood to /Mithras/ or a Mithraic Mysteries member (the target must be controlled).

cards.name: The Mole
cards.text:
Requires a ready anarch. Only usable when a non-anarch minion is acting.
[ani] Only usable by a locked vampire. This vampire unlocks and attempts to block.
[cel] +1 intercept. Not usable if the acting minion has Celerity [cel].
[dom] Only usable when you are being bled by a younger vampire. Lock this vampire to cause the action to fail.

cards.name: The Name Forgotten
cards.text:
[tha] Ⓓ Put this card on a ready unique vampire. If the vampire with this card is burned, he or she is removed from the game instead, and all Methuselahs remove all other vampires with the same name in their crypts, uncontrolled regions and ash heaps from the game as well (shuffle all crypts afterward).
[THA] As above, but this action is at +1 stealth.

cards.name: The New Inquisition
cards.text:
Gehenna. Requires 1 or more other Gehenna events in play. Do not replace until a titled vampire goes to torpor.
During each Methuselah's unlock phase, that Methuselah can choose a ready vampire controlled by their prey. The chosen vampire takes 1 unpreventable environmental damage. Titled vampires can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

cards.name: The Oath
cards.text: Play when a vampire gains blood from a Taste of Vitae or steals blood from this vampire. Put an oath counter on that vampire. This vampire may put another oath counter on that vampire as a Ⓓ action. A vampire with 2 oath counters from this vampire cannot block or enter combat with this vampire. A vampire can play only one Oath each round.

cards.name: The Parthenon
cards.text:
Unique location.
During your master phase, you can lock this card to get +1 master phase action.

cards.name: The Path of Blood
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Cards requiring Quietus [qui] cost Assamites 1 fewer blood. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that inflicts 1 unpreventable environmental damage on acting vampires.

cards.name: The Path of Bone
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Cards requiring Necromancy [nec] cost Giovanni 1 fewer blood. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that inflicts 1 unpreventable environmental damage on acting vampires.

cards.name: The Path of Harmony
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Cards requiring Spiritus [spi] cost Ahrimanes 1 fewer blood. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that inflicts 1 unpreventable environmental damage on acting vampires.

cards.name: The Path of Lilith
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. When a non-Camarilla vampire you control sends an opposing vampire to torpor in combat, you may lock this card to put a torture counter on the opposing vampire. During your unlock phase, each Methuselah who controls any vampires with torture counters burns 1 pool. Any minion may burn this card as a Ⓓ action. Burn all torture counters when this card leaves play.

cards.name: The Path of Metamorphosis
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Cards requiring Vicissitude [vic] cost Tzimisce -1 blood. Minions can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that inflicts 1 unpreventable environmental damage on acting vampires.

cards.name: The Path of Night
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Cards requiring Obtenebration [obt] cost Lasombra 1 fewer blood. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that inflicts 1 unpreventable environmental damage on acting vampires.

cards.name: The Path of Paradox
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Cards requiring Chimerstry [chi] cost Ravnos 1 fewer blood. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that inflicts 1 unpreventable environmental damage on acting vampires.

cards.name: The Path of Retribution
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Cards that require Valeren [val] cost Salubri antitribu 1 less blood. Any minion may burn this card as a Ⓓ action; if that minion is a vampire, he or she takes 1 unpreventable damage when this card is burned.

cards.name: The Path of Service
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Cards requiring Visceratika [vis] cost slave Gargoyles 1 fewer blood. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that inflicts 1 unpreventable environmental damage on acting vampires.

cards.name: The Path of Tears
cards.text:
Out-of-turn. Path. Only usable after you move a Salubri from your uncontrolled region to your ready region during your influence phase.
Put this card on that Salubri. If you burned 3 or more pool for the scarce penalty for this vampire, you gain 3 pool. Cards requiring Obeah [obe] cost this Salubri -1 blood. Minions can burn this card as a Ⓓ action. A vampire can have only one path.

cards.name: The Path of the Feral Heart
cards.printedName: The Path of the Feral Heart
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Cards that require Protean [pro] cost Gangrel antitribu 1 less blood. Any minion may burn this card as a Ⓓ action; if that minion is a vampire, he or she takes 1 unpreventable damage when this card is burned.

cards.name: The Path of the Scorched Heart
cards.printedName: The Path of the Scorched Heart
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Path.
Put this card on this True Brujah and unlock them. Frenzy cards cannot be used on this True Brujah. While this True Brujah is acting or in combat, minions controlled by other Methuselahs cannot play cards requiring Presence [pre]. A vampire can follow only one path.

cards.name: The Path of Typhon
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Cards requiring Serpentis [ser] cost Followers of Set 1 fewer blood. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that inflicts 1 unpreventable environmental damage on acting vampires.

cards.name: The Peace of Khetamon
cards.text: Choose a vampire in torpor. Successful referendum means that vampire is moved to the uncontrolled region (facedown). The vampire's blood counters, master cards and minion cards stay with that vampire, with any counters they have on them (they are out of play as long as the vampire remains uncontrolled).

cards.name: The Platinum Protocol
cards.text:
Requires an Anarch. More than one Discipline can be used to play this card. Ⓓ Bleed.
[obf] This is a +1 stealth action.
[pre] The bleed is with +1 bleed.
[pro] Put 1 corruption counter on a minion controlled by the target Methuselah if the bleed is successful (for 1 or more).

cards.name: The Portrait
cards.text: Ⓓ Show the top card of your prey's crypt to all players. If it is a Nosferatu, this vampire burns 2 blood. If its cost is below 7, this vampire gains 2 blood (ignore excess blood); if it is from 7 to 10, this vampire unlocks and bleeds your prey with +1 bleed as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action; if it is above 10, this vampire burns 1 blood.

cards.name: The Rack
cards.text:
Unique location.
As this location is played or its controller changes, its controller chooses a ready vampire they control. During this location's controller's unlock phase, the chosen vampire can gain 2 blood. Vampires controlled by another Methuselah can steal this location as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: The Realm of the Black Sun
cards.printedName: The Realm of the Black Sun
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. If your prey gains 1 or more pool during their master phase, you can gain 1 pool. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action; titled vampires get -1 stealth during that action.

cards.name: The Red Question
cards.text:
Requires a non-titled non-Anarch vampire.
Put this card on this vampire. This vampire is considered Anarch. Burn this card if this vampire changes sect.

cards.name: The Return to Innocence
cards.text: Ⓓ Bleed. If you successfully bleed your prey for one or more, put this card on the acting vampire. Burn this card if this vampire loses any blood or goes to torpor, or if your prey is ousted. During your next unlock, this vampire is removed from the game and your prey burns X pool, where X is the capacity of this vampire.

cards.name: The Rising
cards.text:
Gehenna. Requires at least 2 other Gehenna events in play. Do not replace until your prey is ousted.
A Methuselah cannot gain pool during their own turn unless they have the Edge or at least 1 victory point (instead, any pool they would gain goes to the blood bank).

cards.name: The Rose (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: The Rose Foundation
cards.text:
Master: unique location.
Lock this location and burn a conviction [1 CONVICTION] from a ready imbued you control to reduce a bleed against you by one or to gain two votes in a referendum.

cards.name: The Rumor Mill, Tabloid Newspaper
cards.text:
Unique location.
You can lock this card during an action to choose a vampire; the chosen vampire can burn 1 blood to get +1 intercept during that action.
cards.flavor:
Rumor: the oldest media in the world.
Jean-François Revel

cards.name: The Sargon Fragment
cards.text:
Unique.
This vampire gets superior Necromancy [NEC]. This vampire can move a library card from your ash heap to your hand as an action that costs 1 blood (discard down afterward).

cards.name: The Secret Library of Alexandria
cards.text:
Master: unique location.
You may draw a card each time you successfully bleed your prey. Discard to your hand size afterward.

cards.name: The Secret Must Be Kept
cards.text:
Requires a Laibon.
Choose an ally or retainer. If the acting Laibon is a magaji, choose up to two allies or retainers instead. Successful referendum means the chosen allies and retainers are burned, and their controllers burn 1 pool (each Methuselah burns no more than 1 pool, regardless of the number of allies and retainers chosen).

cards.name: The Shard, London
cards.text:
Unique location.
If you have the Edge, you can lock this card to reduce the cost of a card you play by 2 pool or blood. Vampires can steal this location as a Ⓓ action; Ventrue get +1 stealth during that action.

cards.name: The Siamese (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: +1 bleed. Sterile.

cards.name: The Signet of King Saul
cards.text:
Unique.
Vampires with capacity 8 or more cannot attempt to block the bearer.

cards.name: The Slashers
cards.text:
Unique mortal with 3 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
The Slashers may strike for 1R damage.

cards.name: The Slaughterhouse
cards.text:
Master: location.
Lock to burn two cards from the top of your prey's library.
cards.flavor:
Death and decay. Decay and death. But the soul survives, even in our inhuman shells. Comprehending the passage of the soul through the physical cycle requires accelerating the process whenever possible.
Anisa Marianna Lopez, Harbinger of Skulls

cards.name: The Sleeping Mind
cards.text:
Only usable as the action is announced.
[dom] Choose a locked vampire. The chosen vampire cannot block this action.
[DOM] During this action, minions cannot unlock.

cards.name: The Slow Withering
cards.text:
Gehenna. Requires 1 or more other Gehenna events in play. Do not replace until a vampire commits diablerie.
Cards requiring 1 or more Disciplines at the superior level cost +1 blood. Vampires who commit diablerie ignore this effect until a Gehenna event is played.
cards.flavor:
It's only a question of time before the withering hits me, and hard.
Beckett, Gangrel

cards.name: The Spawning Pool
cards.text:
Master: unique location.
During your unlock phase, you may move 1 blood from a ready Nosferatu you control to this card. If a minion you control blocks a bleed against you, you may lock this card during the second round of the resulting combat to inflict 1 damage to the acting minion for each blood on the Spawning Pool. This damage cannot be prevented.

cards.name: The Status Perfectus
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready anarch. Unique.
Put this card in play. During your master phase, you may move 1 blood from a ready anarch you control to another ready anarch. When a blocking anarch has just completed combat with an acting minion, you may lock this card and a ready unlocked anarch you control other than the blocking anarch. That anarch enters combat with the acting minion. The acting minion cannot use any strikes in the first round of that combat.

cards.name: The Stranger Among Us
cards.text:
Master.
Search your crypt for a scarce vampire. Show the card to all players and place it face-down in your uncontrolled region.
cards.flavor:
Having unexpected guests, especially of such outlandish nature, can ruin the whole night, but it often brings the best opportunities if one can meet the challenge.
Victoria Ash, Toreador Primogen

cards.name: The Summoning
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[pre] Search your library for an ally or retainer. Show it to all players and put it in your hand (shuffle and discard afterward).
[PRE] Search your library for an ally. This vampire recruits that ally (requirements and cost apply as normal). Shuffle afterward.

cards.name: The Textbook Damnation
cards.text:
Unique.
This vampire gets superior Daimoinon [DAI] and is infernal. Cards requiring Daimoinon [dai] cost this vampire -2 blood. If this vampire is locked during your master phase, burn this equipment.

cards.name: The Treatment
cards.text: Put this card on a prince who has successfully bled you since your last turn. Each time this prince unlocks, they take 1 unpreventable environmental damage. This prince can burn this card as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: The Trick of the Danya
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[chi] Move 1 blood from an uncontrolled minion in your prey's uncontrolled region to your pool or to a vampire in your uncontrolled region.

cards.name: The Uncoiling
cards.text:
Do not replace as long as this card is in play.
During your discard phase, burn another event at random. Other Methuselahs can use a discard phase action and burn X pool to burn this card, where X is the number of other events in play.

cards.name: The Unmasking
cards.text:
Gehenna. Do not replace until your next discard phase.
Allies get +1 intercept against vampires.
cards.flavor:
Those in the grip of panic have an unfortunate habit of disregarding our traditions of Masquerade.
Hardestadt, Ventrue

cards.name: The unnamed (G6)
cards.text: Independent: The unnamed can burn 1 blood to strike: 2R aggravated damage. After it successfully bleeds, you can gain 2 pool. Infernal.

cards.name: The Vozhd of Gravesend
cards.text:
Unique ghoul with 5 life. 4 strength, 0 bleed.
After this ally enters play, burn an ally or retainer you control. This ally can enter combat with a vampire as a Ⓓ action. This ally can prevent 1 damage each round of combat. During combat, this ally can burn 1 life to cancel a strike card as it is played by the opposing minion, and its cost is not paid (the minion chooses a strike again).

cards.name: The Vozhd of Juiz de Fora
cards.printedName: The Vozhd of Juiz de Fora
cards.text:
Unique ghoul with 5 life. 4 strength, 0 bleed.
After this ally enters play, burn an ally or retainer you control. This ally can enter combat with a vampire as a Ⓓ action. This ally can play cards requiring basic Animalism [ani] as a vampire with capacity 5. During your unlock phase, this ally can steal any amount of blood (becoming life) from a Tzimisce you control, not to exceed its starting life.

cards.name: The Vozhd of Sofia
cards.text:
Unique ghoul with 5 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.
After this ally enters play, burn an ally or retainer you control. It can strike: 3R damage. It can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action. During your unlock phase, you can discard an ally or retainer card to add 2 life to this ally.

cards.name: The Vozhd of Szczecin
cards.text:
Unique ghoul with 5 life. 4 strength, 0 bleed.
After this ally enters play, burn an ally or retainer you control. This ally can enter combat with a vampire as a Ⓓ action. Once each combat, this ally can discard a card requiring Protean [pro] to prevent 2 damage. During any other Methuselah's minion phase, a Tzimisce you control can burn 1 blood to unlock this ally.

cards.name: The Warrens
cards.text:
Only usable during an action directed at you (or a card you control).
+2 intercept, with an additional +1 intercept if this Nosferatu is titled.

cards.name: The Wildebeest
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
Put this card on the acting Ahrimane. This Ahrimane gets +1 strength and -1 stealth and gets an optional maneuver each combat. He or she cannot use equipment and cannot have retainers (any retainers on this vampire are burned). A vampire can have only one The Wildebeest.

cards.name: The World's a Canvas
cards.text:
Requires an Anarch.
[dom] Ⓓ Burn half the blood rounded down on a crypt card in your prey's uncontrolled region.
[obf] +1 stealth action. Ⓓ Burn a location.
[vic] Ⓓ Burn 4 blood from a ready titled non-Anarch vampire.

cards.name: Theft of Vitae
cards.text:
[tha] Strike, ranged: steal 1 blood or life (becoming blood).
[THA] Strike, ranged: steal 2 blood or life (becoming blood).
cards.flavor:
The blood is the life!
The blood is the life!
Bram Stoker, "Dracula"

cards.name: Their Master's Voice
cards.text:
Usable by a locked vampire.
Unlock a gargoyle creature ally or a ready slave Gargoyle you control.

cards.name: Thelonius (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Themistocles (G5)
cards.text: Camarilla: Themistocles can burn a location as a Ⓓ action that costs 1 blood.

cards.name: Theo Bell (G2 ADV)
cards.text: Advanced, Independent: +1 strength. If there are any Gehenna cards in play, any justicar or Inner Circle member can call a referendum to burn Theo as a +1 stealth political action. If that referendum is canceled or fails, the acting vampire goes to torpor.

cards.name: Theo Bell (G2)
cards.text: Camarilla: Theo may enter combat with any ready minion controlled by another Methuselah as a Ⓓ action. If you control a ready prince or justicar, blood hunts cannot be called on Theo.

cards.name: Theo Bell (G6)
cards.text: Anarch: Theo can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action. +1 strength.

cards.name: Therbold Realty
cards.text:
Master: unique location.
Locations cost you 1 less blood or pool.
cards.flavor:
Money can't buy friends, but it can get you a better class of enemy.
Spike Milligan

cards.name: Theron (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Theron can put 1 derangement counter on a vampire as a Ⓓ action. If the number of derangement counters equals or exceeds the vampire's capacity, that vampire is considered to be Malkavian antitribu.

cards.name: Thetmes, Caliph of Alamut (G2)
cards.title: 2 votes
cards.text: Independent. 2 votes (titled): Damage from Thetmes's hand strikes is aggravated. Blood cursed.

cards.name: Thicker than Blood
cards.text: Choose a ready Blood Brother you control. Move a unique Blood Brother of the same circle from your uncontrolled region to your ready region. Not usable if they would contest a card in play.

cards.name: Thin Blood
cards.text:
Only usable at close range before strikes are chosen. A vampire can play only one Thin Blood each round.
[qui] The opposing vampire burns 1 blood.
[QUI] The opposing vampire burns 2 blood.

cards.name: Thin-Blooded Seer
cards.text:
Requires a ready non-sterile vampire of capacity less than 3.
Put this card into play; it becomes a 1-capacity vampire. This vampire is clanless and sterile. This vampire is not considered unique, must hunt this turn and is the same sect as the acting vampire. Cards that cost blood cost this vampire twice as much blood to play. During your unlock phase, you may lock this vampire to look at the top two cards of any Methuselah's library.

cards.name: Thing
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
Add 2 blood to a Gangrel in your uncontrolled region.

cards.name: Third Tradition: Progeny
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a non-sterile prince or justicar.
Put this card in play. It becomes a 1-capacity (non-unique) Camarilla vampire of the same clan as the acting vampire and cannot perform actions this turn. You can search your library (shuffle afterward), hand and/or ash heap for a Discipline master card and put it on this new vampire. Move up to 2 blood from the acting vampire to this new vampire.
cards.flavor: Thou shalt only sire another with the permission of thine elder.

cards.name: Thirst
cards.text:
Gehenna.
After each Methuselah's minion phase ends, each ready vampire controlled by that Methuselah with capacity less than the number of Gehenna events in play who did not hunt during that minion phase burns 1 blood.
cards.flavor:
Night after night. Rising, hunting, killing, feeding. Nothing more than ambulatory corpses without the good sense to lie down and be still.
Felton, Tremere

cards.name: Thomas De Lutrius (G4)
cards.title: Primogen
cards.text: Camarilla primogen: Burn 1 pool after Thomas goes to torpor.

cards.name: Thomas Steed, The Angry (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Thomas may search your library for a melee weapon and move it to your hand as a +1 stealth action. Discard down to your hand size and shuffle your library afterward.

cards.name: Thomas Thorne (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Thomasso Ghiberti (G4)
cards.text: Independent: During your unlock phase, you can move 1 blood from a Laibon you control to Thomasso.

cards.name: Those Who Endure Judge
cards.text:
Requires a Laibon with capacity above 4. Only usable when the action is announced.
The acting vampire gets two additional votes in any referendums conducted during this action (even blood hunt referendums). Any younger vampire successfully blocking this action burns 1 blood (before combat, if any). If he or she cannot, the block fails and the action continues as if unblocked.

cards.name: Thoughts Betrayed
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined on the first round.
[dom] Opposing minion takes 1 additional damage in the first round of combat during normal strike resolution.
[DOM] Opposing minion cannot play any strike cards for the duration of this combat.

cards.name: Threading the Path of Orpheus
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
Burn a card played by another Methuselah on a vampire you control. Lock that vampire.

cards.name: Threats
cards.text:
Only usable during a bleed action.
[dom] +1 bleed (limited).
[DOM] +2 bleed (limited).
cards.flavor:
As by tenderness and ruth
Others rule thy life and youth,
I by terror choose to reign.
Charles Baudelaire, "The Revenant"

cards.name: Three's a Crowd
cards.text:
Requires a ready unlocked Blood Brother of the same circle as another one you control in combat.
Only usable before range is determined. The range this round is automatically close, and the Blood Brother in combat gets an optional press, only usable to continue combat.

cards.name: Threestar Cab Company
cards.text:
Master: unique location. Hunting ground.
Lock during your master phase to move a blood from the blood bank to this card. Lock during your unlock phase to move 1 blood from this card to your pool or to a ready vampire you control. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground card each turn.

cards.name: Thrones Crumble
cards.text:
[ser] Ⓓ Burn 2 blood from a ready titled vampire.
[SER] As above, and lock the target vampire.
cards.flavor:
For there's no greater evil than a lack of leadership. That destroys whole cities, turns households into ruins, and in war makes soldiers break and run away.
Sophocles, "Antigon"

cards.name: Thrown Gate
cards.text:
[pot] Strike: 1R damage, with an optional maneuver.
[POT] Strike: 2R damage, with an optional maneuver.
cards.flavor:
Just be glad we aren't back in the days when most gates were made out of wood.
Angela Decker, Pander

cards.name: Thrown Sewer Lid
cards.text:
Only usable at long range.
[pot] Strike: 3R damage.
[POT] As above, with an optional press.

cards.name: Thucimia (G4)
cards.title: 1 vote
cards.text: Independent. 1 vote (titled): During a bleed action, Thucimia can give you -2 hand size until your next unlock phase to get +1 bleed. Blood cursed. +1 hand size.

cards.name: Tiberius, The Scandalmonger (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla: If Tiberius is ready during your unlock phase, you may look at the top card in your prey's library.

cards.name: Tier of Souls
cards.text:
[ani] Ⓓ Steal 1 blood or life from a minion controlled by your prey.
[ANI] As above, and put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +1 bleed against your prey. Minions can burn this card as a Ⓓ action. A vampire can have only one Tier of Souls.

cards.name: Timothy Crowley (G1)
cards.title: Prince
cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Dallas.

cards.name: Tinglestripe
cards.text:
Weapon. This weapon can be used to strike only once each round.
[myt] Strike: 2R damage.
[MYT] As above, or strike: 1R damage, with 1 optional maneuver each combat.

cards.name: Tithings
cards.text:
Requires a ready Sabbat vampire with a capacity above 6.
Successful referendum means you steal 1 pool from each Methuselah who does not control a vampire with a capacity above 6.

cards.name: Titi Camara (G5)
cards.text: Laibon.

cards.name: Titus Camille (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: Titus can steal equipment from a minion controlled by your predator or prey as a Ⓓ action. +1 strength.

cards.name: Tobias Smith (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat: Tobias can give any other non-titled Sabbat vampire you control with capacity 6 or more the title of bishop as an action.

cards.name: Toby (G4)
cards.text: Camarilla: During a bleed action, Toby can burn a blood to give an acting anarch +1 bleed.

cards.name: Tock (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Tom (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat. Chicago Circle: Cards that require Sanguinus [san] cost Tom an additional blood. Sterile.

cards.name: Tomaine (G4)
cards.title: Primogen
cards.text: Camarilla primogen: While Tomaine is ready and your prey controls a ready Sabbat vampire, your prey gets +1 hand size.

cards.name: Tomb of Rameses III
cards.text:
Master: unique location.
When this card is played or the controller of this card changes, the controller chooses a vampire in his or her uncontrolled region. For each blood counter you transfer to the chosen vampire during your influence phase, move one counter from the blood bank to the Tomb. At the end of your influence phase, if the total number of counters on the chosen vampire and on the Tomb equals or exceeds that vampire's capacity, you may move the vampire to the ready region. Burn this card (and the counters on it) when this vampire leaves the uncontrolled region.

cards.name: Tommaso Sforza (G6)
cards.text: Independent: Once each turn, if he is ready, Tommaso can burn 1 blood before range is determined in a combat involving a wraith or zombie ally you control to end that combat.

cards.name: Tommy (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Tongue of the Serpent
cards.text:
[ser] Strike: steal 1 blood or life (becoming blood).
[SER] Strike: steal 2 blood or life (becoming blood).
cards.flavor:
No matter what he hope or plan,
There is no moment left when man
Is not subject to the constant
Warnings of this odious Serpent.
Charles Baudelaire, "The Serpent's Tooth"

cards.name: Tony (G3)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Topaz (G4)
cards.text: Camarilla: When Topaz successfully equips from your hand, you may look at your prey's hand, and Topaz may take an equipment from it instead (discard the original equipment card).

cards.name: Toreador Grand Ball
cards.text: Choose two ready Toreador you control, put this card in play, and lock one of the two. The locked Toreador does not unlock as normal. The other Toreador's non-bleed actions cannot be blocked. Minions can burn this card as a Ⓓ action; Nosferatu get -1 stealth during that action.

cards.name: Toreador Justicar
cards.text:
Title.
Choose a ready Toreador. Successful referendum means this card is put on the chosen Toreador to represent the unique Camarilla title of Toreador Justicar. In this referendum, each ready Toreador gets +1 vote.

cards.name: Toreador's Bane
cards.text:
Only usable in combat with a Toreador, Toreador antitribu, ally or younger vampire.
[pre] Strike: combat ends.
[mel] Strike: combat ends. After combat ends, if this vampire was blocked while performing a non-bleed non-political action, the action continues as if unblocked.
[MEL] As [mel] above, but usable to continue a bleed or political action.

cards.name: Tori Longwood (G2)
cards.text: Anarch: After your minion phase ends, lock Tori if she did not perform an action this turn.

cards.name: Torment the Soul
cards.text:
Not usable during the first round of combat.
[nec] Strike: 1R damage.
[NEC] Strike: 1R aggravated damage.
cards.flavor:
Suppose the yesterdays ate up our grand tomorrows?
If the old madness came this way?
Paul Verlaine, "Sagesse", Book One

cards.name: Torn Signpost
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[pot] This vampire gets a strength of 2 this combat.
[POT] This vampire gets a strength of 3 this combat.

cards.name: Torpid Blood
cards.text:
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire moves from torpor to the ready region.
Actions performed by vampires in torpor cost +1 blood. Rescuing an older vampire from torpor costs +1 blood.
cards.flavor:
There is no after for us, and yet there is an after if kine survive.
Anonymous Malkavian, "Das Buch vom Grabkrieg"

cards.name: Torrent
cards.text:
[cel] Additional strike (limited).
[CEL] Strike: combat ends. If this vampire was blocked while performing an action, the action continues as if unblocked.

cards.name: Tortured Confession
cards.text:
Only usable when the opposing vampire goes into torpor. Not usable by a vampire being burned or going to torpor.
Combat ends. You may look at the opposing vampire's controller's hand.
cards.flavor:
To chase one's victim, to prepare one's plan minutely, to slake an implacable vengeance, and then to go to bed... There is nothing sweeter in the world.
Josef Stalin

cards.name: Torvus Bloodbeard (G3)
cards.text: Independent: During any Methuselah's minion phase, you may burn the Edge to unlock Torvus. +1 strength.

cards.name: Total Insanity
cards.text:
[dem] Ⓓ Put this card on an ally or younger vampire. The attached minion gets -1 stealth. During their unlock phase, add 1 counter to this card. Burn this card if it has 3 counters.
[DEM] As above, and the attached minion cannot play action cards.

cards.name: Touch of Clarity
cards.text:
Usable by a ready unlocked vampire other than the acting minion.
[dem] Cancel a non-combat card requiring Dementation [dem], Dominate [dom] or Presence [pre] as it is played, and its cost is not paid. Lock this vampire.
[DEM] As above, but do not lock this vampire.

cards.name: Touch of Oblivion
cards.text:
[obl] Strike: put this card on the opposing minion with 2 counters. The attached minion burns 1 counter from this card instead of unlocking as normal. If this card has no counters, burn it.
[OBL] Strike: send the opposing vampire to torpor or burn the opposing ally.

cards.name: Touch of Pain
cards.text:
Only usable when a bleed against you is successful or a referendum passes. Play after resolution.
[pot] This vampire inflicts 1 damage on the acting minion. Only one Touch of Pain can be played each action.
[POT] As above, but for 2 damage.

cards.name: Touch of Valeren
cards.text:
[for] [ACTION] +1 stealth action. Add 3 blood or life to a minion, not to exceed their starting life.
[for] [COMBAT] Prevent all damage from the opposing minion's strike.
[FOR] [COMBAT] Only usable by a ready vampire not involved in the combat involving another minion you control. Prevent all damage to that minion from the opposing minion's strike.

cards.name: Tourette's Voice
cards.text:
[aus] +1 intercept.
[mel] Give a minion you control (even this one) +1 intercept.
[MEL] Give a minion +1 intercept.
cards.flavor:
As we stand on the edge of darkness
Let our chant fill the void
That others may know ...
Tibetan Book of the Dead

cards.name: Tower of London
cards.text:
Unique location.
Lock after resolution of a successful action requiring Necromancy [nec] to gain 1 pool.

cards.name: Toy (G5)
cards.text: Sabbat: Toy cannot act or block. Toy Chest Test cannot be played on him. Malkavian antitribu slave.

cards.name: Toy Chest Test
cards.text:
Master. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire with a capacity above 4.
Burn a Sabbat vampire with a capacity below 4 that has been put into play since your last turn (not usable on a vampire that has been contested).
cards.flavor:
Toy is a national treasure. We'd never let him go.
Preacher, Malkavian antitribu

cards.name: Tracker's Mark
cards.text: Play when the opposing minion burns blood or life due to damage. Put this card on the opposing minion. This Salubri antitribu gets +1 intercept when attempting to block the minion with this card. If the vampire with this card is Tremere or Baali, this Salubri antitribu can enter combat with him or her as a Ⓓ action. The minion with this card may burn it as a +1 stealth action. A vampire can play only one Tracker's Mark each combat.

cards.name: Tradition Upheld
cards.text:
Requires a prince, justicar, or Inner Circle member.
Choose a ready Caitiff. If this referendum is successful, burn that Caitiff.
cards.flavor:
The tradition finally becomes holy and inspires awe.
Friedrich Nietzsche, "Human, All Too Human"

cards.name: Traditionalist
cards.text:
Master: archetype. Trifle.
Put this card on a vampire you control. Once per turn, when this vampire casts his or her votes or ballots against a referendum and the referendum fails, he or she gains 1 blood from the blood bank. A vampire can have only one archetype.
cards.flavor:
We are stubborn, self-destructive conformists. Any other view of our species is just a self-congratulatory delusion.
Michael Crichton, "The Lost World"

cards.name: Tragic Love Affair
cards.text:
Master.
Put this card on a Toreador. Lock that Toreador. The Toreador suffering the Tragic Love Affair does not unlock during the unlock phase. The Toreador's controller may burn 1 pool during his or her master phase to transfer this card to another Toreador. A Methuselah can burn the Edge to burn this card.

cards.name: Trainer
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
[ani] Ⓓ Steal an animal retainer controlled by another Methuselah.
[ANI] Put this card on this acting vampire. When this vampire is acting or in combat, cards that require Animalism cost other vampires an additional blood, and animal retainers employed by other minions lose their abilities. A vampire can have only one Trainer.

cards.name: Tranquility
cards.text:
Only usable by a ready vampire not involved in combat.
[dom] Cancel a frenzy card as it is played (no cost is paid).
[DOM] As above, and the target of the frenzy card gets an optional press, only usable to end combat.
cards.flavor:
Enough! Be seated and be quiet, both of you.
Don Michael Antonio Giovanni, Giovanni "Prince" of Las Vegas

cards.name: Tranquility Shield
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined during the first round.
[for] This combat, this vampire can prevent 1 damage each round. This combat, frenzy cards cannot be used on this vampire; cancel the effects of frenzy cards that have already been used on this vampire this combat.
[FOR] As above, but this vampire can prevent 2 damage each round.

cards.name: Transcendent Laibon
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card on a Laibon with at least three Aye and three Orun. During your unlock phase, this Laibon gains 1 blood. Allies and younger vampires must burn 1 blood or life to attempt to block this Laibon or to perform an action directed at this Laibon. Burn this card if this minion is not ready or has fewer than three Aye or three Orun.

cards.name: Transfer of Power
cards.text: Successful referendum means you steal 1 pool from each Methuselah who has more pool than you do.

cards.name: Transfusion
cards.text:
[nec] Only usable after resolution of a successful action. Add 1 blood to a ready vampire.
[thn] As [nec] above, but add 1 life to a ghoul or 1 blood to a ready vampire.
[THN] Only usable after combat if this vampire is still ready and successfully inflicted any damage on the opposing minion during that combat. Put 1 transfusion counter on the opposing minion. If the opposing minion has 3 of your transfusion counters, burn them to steal the opposing minion. Only one Transfusion can be played at superior each turn.

cards.name: Trap
cards.text:
Only usable before range is determined during the first round of combat.
Put this card in play with 3 counters. Each time a card is played this combat, reset the number of counters on this card to 3. During the press step of each round this combat, this Trap automatically burns 1 counter from itself to provide 1 press to continue combat (either combatant can press to end combat). Burn this card at the end of combat.

cards.name: Travelers Obey the Tenets
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready magaji.
Put this card in play. When a vampire successfully takes an action directed at you, that vampire takes 1 unpreventable damage (after resolving the action). Any vampire may burn this card (and take no damage from it) as a Ⓓ action. A Methuselah may have only one Travelers Obey the Tenets.

cards.name: Travis "Traveler72" Miller (G4)
cards.text: Travis may move 2 blood from the blood bank to an imbued in your uncontrolled region as a +1 stealth action that costs 1 conviction [1 CONVICTION].

cards.name: Treachery
cards.text:
Only usable during a referendum before any votes and ballots are cast.
[pre] If the referendum passes, the controller of the vampire calling the referendum burns 1 pool.
[PRE] As above, and any other Methuselahs who cast votes or ballots in favor of the referendum burn 1 pool when the votes are tallied.

cards.name: Treasured Samadji
cards.text:
Unique.
This Ravnos gets +1 bleed. Once each combat, this Ravnos can strike: dodge.

cards.name: Treat the Sick Mind
cards.text:
[dem] [ACTION] Unlock an ally or younger vampire.
[obe] [ACTION] As [dem] above, with +1 stealth.
[OBE] [REACTION] Cancel a card as it is played by another Methuselah that would be put on a vampire with Dementation [dem] they do not control. Usable even if there is no action.

cards.name: Treaty of Laibach
cards.text:
Unique. Requires both Follower of Set and Tremere.
Put this card in play. Each Follower of Set is considered to have a level of Blood Sorcery [tha] equal to their level of Serpentis [ser]. Each Tremere is considered to have a level of Serpentis equal to theirs level of Blood Sorcery.

cards.name: Treaty of Tyre Enforced
cards.text: If this referendum is successful, each Methuselah burns X+1 pool, where X is the number of Assamites he or she controls.

cards.name: Tremere Convocation
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. Tremere get +1 stealth during actions requiring Blood Sorcery [tha]. Vampires with basic Blood Sorcery can play combat cards requiring Blood Sorcery as if they had superior Blood Sorcery [THA]. Any minion can burn this card as a Ⓓ action; Malkavians get -1 stealth during that action.

cards.name: Tremere Justicar
cards.text:
Title.
Choose a ready Tremere. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen Tremere to represent the unique Camarilla title of Tremere Justicar. In this referendum, each Tremere gets 1 extra vote.

cards.name: Trevon Parker (G6)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Tribunal Judgment
cards.text:
Requires a Sabbat vampire.
Choose a vampire who cast any votes in the most recent referendum (must be since your last turn). Successful referendum means that vampire takes X damage, where X is the number of votes he or she cast in that previous referendum.

cards.name: Tribute to the Master
cards.text: Move 1 blood from each ready vampire you control to your pool.
cards.flavor:
All these lives I will give you, ay, and many more and greater, through countless ages...
Bram Stoker, "Dracula"

cards.name: Triole's Revenge
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
Ⓓ Put this card on a Ventrue who is not at full capacity. A Ventrue suffering Triole's Revenge must hunt once each minion phase as his or her first action. If the Ventrue hunts while at full capacity, he or she is burned. Any Ventrue can take an action to burn this card.

cards.name: Trochomancy
cards.text:
Only usable during a bleed action.
[nec] Remove thirteen cards in the target Methuselah's ash heap from the game to get +1 bleed (limited).
[aus][nec] As [nec] above, but remove only seven cards.
[AUS][NEC] As [aus][nec] above, but for +2 bleed (limited).

cards.name: Troglodytia (G4)
cards.text: Independent: After any Methuselah plays a master card, you may look at that Methuselah's hand (after the replacement card is drawn). +1 strength.

cards.name: Troius (G4)
cards.title: Prince
cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Geneva: Troius cannot cast votes or ballots against blood hunt referendums. +1 strength.

cards.name: Trophy: Chosen
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
When this card is moved to a vampire, that vampire gains 4 blood, becomes Sabbat and unlocks, or that vampire can choose to burn this card instead. The vampire with this card is Black Hand. If he or she was already Black Hand when receiving this card, he or she is a Seraph.

cards.name: Trophy: Clan Respect
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
When this card enters play, choose a clan. Vampires of the chosen clan cannot block the vampire with this card.
cards.flavor:
You solve this problem for me... and I will join my voice with yours when it comes time to formalize our new structure.
Hardestadt, Ventrue

cards.name: Trophy: Diablerie
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
The vampire with this card gets +2 stealth when attempting diablerie. Blood hunts cannot be called against this vampire. If this vampire successfully diablerizes another vampire, burn this card at the end of the action.

cards.name: Trophy: Discipline
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
When this card enters play, choose a Discipline. The vampire with this card has the chosen Discipline at the superior level.
cards.flavor:
They taught you to hear them dead people? Think you could teach me?
Joe "Boot" Hill, Assamite antitribu

cards.name: Trophy: Domain
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
The vampire with this card has +1 intercept. Once each action, this vampire can burn 1 blood to unlock and attempt to block.
cards.flavor:
The Camarilla will formally acknowledge the supremacy of Clan Giovanni in Boston and its immediate environs.
Jacques Gauthier, Toreador

cards.name: Trophy: Hunting Ground
cards.text:
Master. Trophy. Hunting ground.
During your unlock phase, the vampire with this card gains 2 blood from the blood bank. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground card each turn.

cards.name: Trophy: Library
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
The controller of this vampire gets +2 hand size. A vampire may have no more than two Trophy: Libraries.
cards.flavor:
The greatest university of all is a collection of books.
Thomas Carlyle

cards.name: Trophy: No Questions
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
Put 2 counters on this card. When the vampire with this card announces an action, he or she may burn a counter from it to make the action unblockable. Burn this card when it has no counters.

cards.name: Trophy: Progeny
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
If this card would be moved to a non-sterile vampire, that vampire's controller takes control of it instead, and it becomes a non-unique vampire of the same clan and sect as that vampire with 2 capacity. He or she may go through his or her library (shuffle afterward), ash heap or hand to find a Discipline card for this new vampire. Move 2 blood from the blood bank to this new vampire.

cards.name: Trophy: Retainers
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
During your unlock phase, if this card is on a vampire, you may search your library (shuffle afterward) or hand for a retainer. This vampire employs that retainer (he or she must meet the requirements, if any). Pay the cost as normal. This is not an action.

cards.name: Trophy: Revered
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
The vampire with this card gets +2 bleed. A vampire may have only one Trophy: Revered.
cards.flavor:
It is hard to free fools from the chains they revere.
Voltaire

cards.name: Trophy: Safe Passage
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
While the vampire with this card is ready, he or she cannot be the target of other Methuselahs' actions.
cards.flavor:
I want a promise that I won't be interfered with by the prince's sheriff.
Khalil Ravana, Ravnos

cards.name: Trophy: Wealth
cards.text:
Master. Trophy.
When this card is placed on a vampire, put five counters on it. The vampire with this card can use these counters to pay some or all of the blood or pool cost of equipment. Burn this card when the last counter is removed.

cards.name: True Faith
cards.text:
Unique.
Put this card on a non-infernal mortal ally you control, or burn 2 pool to put this card on a non-infernal minion you control. This minion cannot be the target of directed actions requiring Dominate [dom] or Presence [pre]. In combat, damage this minion inflicts on infernal minions is aggravated. Infernal minions cannot block or strike against this minion. Burn this card if this minion becomes infernal.

cards.name: True Love's Face
cards.text:
[obf][pre] Only usable during a bleed action. +1 bleed (limited).
[OBF][PRE] Only usable if a minion attempts to block. That attempt fails and the blocking minion cannot attempt to block this action again. The blocking minion's controller can burn 1 pool to cancel this card as it is played.

cards.name: Truman (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat. Torrance Circle: Sterile.

cards.name: Trumped-Up Charges
cards.text:
Requires a titled non-Red List vampire.
Choose a ready non-Red List minion. If this referendum succeeds, put this card on that minion. This minion is now Red List. In this referendum, the chosen minion's controller gets 2 additional votes for every Red List minion in play. Any titled vampire may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action. Burn this card if the minion is no longer Red List.

cards.name: Trung Chau Pham (G7)
cards.text: Anarch.

cards.name: Truth in Darkness
cards.text:
[obl] +1 intercept.
[OBL] As above, and if this vampire blocks, they can burn 1 blood to unlock after block resolution.

cards.name: Truth in Ink
cards.text:
Requires a Black Hand vampire.
Only usable when a vampire who is not Black Hand is bleeding you. Reduce the bleed amount by 2.

cards.name: Truth of a Thousand Lies
cards.text:
[ser] Only usable during a bleed action. +2 bleed (limited).
[SER] Only usable after resolution of a successful action. Unlock this vampire.
cards.flavor:
A lie gets halfway around the world before the truth has a chance to get its pants on.
Winston Churchill

cards.name: Truth of Blood
cards.text:
[aus][qui] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed. If this action is blocked, the blocking minion's controller discards 2 cards at random before block resolution. Those cards are not replaced until after this action.
[AUS][QUI] As above, but bleed with +2 bleed.

cards.name: Tryphosa (G4)
cards.title: Prince
cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Rome: While Tryphosa is ready, any Malkavian's bleed actions cost 1 additional blood and get +1 stealth.

cards.name: Tsigane (G2)
cards.text: Independent.

cards.name: Tsunda (G4)
cards.title: Magaji
cards.text: Laibon magaji.

cards.name: Tumnimos
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a non-sterile Ravnos with capacity 5 or more.
Put this card in play; it becomes a 2-capacity (non-unique) Ravnos of the same sect as the acting Ravnos with basic Chimerstry [chi], and must hunt this turn. You can put a master Discipline card from your hand on this new vampire.

cards.name: Tunnel Runner
cards.text:
Werewolf with 3 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
The Runner may play cards that require Animalism [ani] as a vampire and may burn 1 life to get +1 stealth. If he successfully bleeds, you may look at the target Methuselah's hand. A vampire stealing life from the Runner takes 1 damage for each point stolen. If the Runner has 2 or fewer life during your unlock phase, he gains 1 life.

cards.name: Tupdog (G3)

cards.text:
Transient.
During your next discard phase, you must burn this card, and you may either burn a vampire in torpor or, by locking a ready werewolf ally you control or discarding a White Nights Massacre from your hand, burn all vampires in torpor.

cards.name: White Phosphorus Grenade
cards.text:
Weapon.
2R aggravated damage each strike. If White Phosphorus Grenade is used at close range, the minion with this equipment takes 1 aggravated damage. Burn after use.
cards.flavor:
The sky is darkening like a stain;
Something is going to fall like rain,
And it won't be flowers.
W.H. Auden, "The Witnesses"

cards.name: Wider View
cards.text:
Trifle.
Put this card in play. You can use 1 transfer to draw 1 card from your crypt and then remove a crypt card in your uncontrolled region from the game. You can use 4 transfers to burn this card and gain 2 pool.

cards.name: Wilhelm Waldburg (G2)
cards.title: Prince
cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Berlin: If Wilhelm's title is contested, the cost of contesting is increased by 1 blood for the other vampire(s).

cards.name: Will of the Council
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready primogen.
Put this card on the acting primogen. During the referendum of a political action, this primogen can burn 1 blood to gain 1 vote. This primogen can burn this card to play a card that requires a prince as if he or she were a prince. This primogen can burn this card when a prince enters torpor to receive (and contest) the same title as that prince. A vampire can have only 1 Will of the Council.

cards.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
cards.text:
[chi] Allocate X+1 points among one or more minions. Each minion gets -1 intercept for each point allocated.
[CHI] Only usable as the action is announced. Choose X-1 allies or younger vampires. The chosen minions cannot block or play reaction cards this action.

cards.name: William Biltmore (G3)
cards.text: Camarilla: Once each action, William can burn 1 blood to get +1 stealth. +1 bleed.

cards.name: William Thorbecke (G5)
cards.title: Primogen
cards.text: Camarilla primogen: During your discard phase, William can burn 2 blood to unlock a minion you control.

cards.name: Winchester Mansion
cards.text:
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
The vampire with this location has superior Dementation [DEM]. At the end of your master phase, if you did not play a master card from your hand this phase, this vampire burns 1 blood.
cards.flavor:
I am glad that it is old and big. I myself am of an old family, and to live in a new house would kill me.
Bram Stoker, "Dracula"

cards.name: Wind Dance
cards.text:
[tha] Strike: dodge.
[THA] As above, with 1 additional strike: dodge (limited).

cards.name: Winged Second
cards.text: [FLIGHT] Only usable when another minion you control enters combat with a minion without flight. Lock this minion. In that combat, this minion may make a hand or melee weapon strike (with or without a strike card) on the opposing minion during normal strike resolution (as if at close range). Dodge will avoid this strike, and damage prevention effects can treat this as a strike from an opposing minion. This minion may be the target of effects that inflict damage or steal blood as a retainer could be.

cards.name: Winterlich (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat: Winterlich can recruit a changeling ally as if he met the requirements of playing that card. While he is ready, changelings cost you 1 fewer pool.

cards.name: Wise Frog (G6)
cards.text: Camarilla: Wise Frog strikes with first strike in combat with a younger vampire. Blood cursed.

cards.name: Wise Spider
cards.text:
+1 stealth action.
Put this card on this acting Akunanse. If this action is successful, unlock the acting vampire at the end of the turn. While this Akunanse is ready, your hand size is one card larger. A vampire may have only one Wise Spider.
cards.flavor:
To travel is to see. To travel is to learn.
Hasani, Akunanse

cards.name: Withering
cards.text:
[ani] Strike: 1R damage.
[thn] Strike: hand strike. Place this card on the opposing minion. The minion with this card has -1 strength. Burn this card during his or her controller's next discard phase.
[THN] As [thn] above, and the minion with this card cannot play cards that require any Disciplines.

cards.name: WMRH Talk Radio
cards.text:
Unique location.
You can lock this card to give a minion +1 intercept. If that minion does not block the action, burn 1 pool after action resolution.

cards.name: Wolf Claws
cards.text:
[pro] Damage from this vampire's hand strikes is aggravated this round.
[PRO] Press.
cards.flavor:
How cheerfully he seems to grin,
How neatly spread his claws...
Lewis Carroll, "Alice in Wonderland"

cards.name: Wolf Companion
cards.text:
Animal with 2 life.
[ani] When the minion with this retainer is in combat, the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution (if the range is close).
[ANI] As above, but Wolf Companion has 3 life.
cards.flavor:
It is you -- my equal, my companion and close friend.
Psalms 55:13 (NLT)

cards.name: Wolf Valentine (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat: Wolf gets 1 optional press per combat, only usable to continue combat, when in combat with a Tremere.

cards.name: Wolfgang (G3)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Wooden Stake
cards.text:
Melee weapon.
Strike: strength damage. If more than 1 damage is inflicted on an opposing vampire by this weapon in a given combat, that vampire is sent to torpor. In that case, this card is transferred to that vampire, and he or she doesn't unlock as normal during the unlock phase as long as he or she remains in torpor.

cards.name: Wormwood
cards.text:
Gehenna. Requires 1 or more other Gehenna events in play. Do not replace until your next discard phase.
This card comes into play with 10 counters. After another Gehenna event is played, burn 1 counter from this card. Vampires with capacity greater than X are considered vampires with capacity X (minimum of 1), where X is the number of counters on this card.

cards.name: Wrath of the Inner Circle
cards.text:
Requires an Inner Circle member.
Choose a ready justicar. If the referendum is successful, put this card on that justicar. The justicar loses his or her title, and his or her capacity decreases by 1. (A vampire's capacity cannot go below 1.)

cards.name: Wren (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Writ of Acceptance
cards.text:
Equipment.
The vampire with this equipment is considered a Camarilla vampire.

cards.name: Wrong and Crosswise
cards.text:
[dem] Reduce a bleed against you by 2.
[DEM] Only usable during the polling step of a political action. This vampire gets +4 votes against the referendum.

cards.name: Wynn (G1)
cards.title: Primogen
cards.text: Camarilla primogen: Wynn may enter combat with a vampire controlled by your predator or prey as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Xaviar (G3 ADV)
cards.title: Justicar
cards.text: Camarilla Gangrel Justicar: You can unlock Xaviar after a referendum called by him passes.

cards.name: Xaviar (G3)
cards.title: 2 votes
cards.text: Independent: Xaviar has 2 votes (titled). He can prevent 1 damage each combat. Once each combat, before range is determined, he may burn 2 blood to get +2 strength for the remainder of combat.

cards.name: Xendil Charmer (G4)
cards.title: Priscus
cards.text: Sabbat priscus.

cards.name: Xeper, Sultan of Lepers (G6)
cards.text: Independent: Xeper gets +1 vote for each ready unique infernal vampire you control. He can steal an ally controlled by another Methuselah as a Ⓓ action. Infernal.

cards.name: Xian "DziDzat155" Quan (G4)
cards.text: If Xian successfully blocks a monster and is still ready at the end of the action, he may gain a conviction [1 CONVICTION] from your hand or ash heap.

cards.name: Ximena (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Xipe Totec (G5)
cards.title: Archbishop
cards.text: Sabbat Archbishop of Guatemala City: Xipe can steal an ally or retainer as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action that costs 1 blood. +1 strength.

cards.name: XTC-Laced Blood
cards.text:
Master: out-of-turn.
Only usable when a vampire successfully hunts. Put this card on that vampire. During this vampire's minion phase, he or she must hunt, even if at capacity. Any vampire may burn this card as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Yael (G7)
cards.text: Independent.

cards.name: Yasmin the Black (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat. Black Hand.

cards.name: Yavu Matebo (G4)
cards.text: Independent: While ready, Yavu may burn 2 blood to cause an ally or younger vampire's action to fail as it is announced. If he does so, Yavu moves to the uncontrolled region (after breaking any temporary control effects on him). Scarce.

cards.name: Yawp Court
cards.text:
Unique location. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
If a political action is successful, before the referendum, you can lock this location and a ready unlocked Sabbat vampire you control to have that vampire enter combat with the acting vampire. If the acting vampire is still ready at the end of combat, the Sabbat vampire takes 2 environmental damage and the referendum is conducted as normal.

cards.name: Yazid Tamari (G3 ADV)
cards.text:
Sabbat: Yazid gets +1 stealth during directed actions. Black Hand.
[MERGED] Anarch.

cards.name: Yazid Tamari (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat: Black Hand. Seraph. +1 bleed.

cards.name: Year of Fortune
cards.text: Choose one or more Methuselahs who are not chosen for any other Year of Fortune in play. If this referendum is successful, put this card into play. Each chosen Methuselah gets +1 hand size. Any vampire can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

cards.name: Yewon Ong (G6)
cards.title: Prince
cards.text: Camarilla Prince of Singapore: During the polling step of any referendum, Yewon can discard a card requiring Oblivion [obl] to get +1 vote.

cards.name: Yitzak (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat: Yitzak may lock a younger vampire as a Ⓓ action. If successful, that vampire does not unlock as normal during his or her next unlock phase.

cards.name: Yong-Sun, Harmonist (G2 ADV)
cards.title: Cardinal
cards.text: Advanced, Sabbat cardinal: Yong-Sun gets +X bleed, where X is the number of vampires in the target Methuselah's ash heap.

cards.name: Yong-Sun, Harmonist (G2)
cards.title: Cardinal
cards.text: Sabbat cardinal: Yong-Sun may burn the top card of your prey's crypt as a Ⓓ action.

cards.name: Yorik (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Yoruba Shrine
cards.text:
Unique location.
If a ready Assamite you control is the target of a directed action or is chosen by the acting Methuselah in the terms of a referendum, you can lock this location to unlock the acting minion and have the action or referendum fail. Only usable as the directed action is announced or during the polling step of the referendum before votes and ballots are cast.

cards.name: Young Bloods
cards.text:
Unique mortal with 3 life. 2 strength, 0 bleed.
The Young Bloods can burn 2 blood from a locked vampire with a capacity less than 8 as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. If a vampire controlled by another Methuselah burns the Young Bloods in combat or as an action, he or she gains 2 blood.

cards.name: Ysador the Foul (G4)
cards.title: Cardinal
cards.text: Sabbat cardinal: Non-infernal, non-demon minions opposing Ysador in combat cannot use maneuvers to maneuver to close range.

cards.name: Yseult (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat: After you replace a card requiring Melpominee [mel] Yseult played, you can draw 1 additional card. She cannot block vampires with capacity 5 or more.

cards.name: Yurena, The Boor (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Yuri Kerezenski (G4)
cards.title: Bishop
cards.text: Sabbat bishop.

cards.name: Yuri, The Talon (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Yusuf, Scribe of Alamut (G2)
cards.text: Independent: If Yusuf performs a successful action to equip with an equipment requiring an Assamite, he can unlock during the discard phase. Blood cursed.

cards.name: Yvette, The Hopeless (G3)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Zachary (G2)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Zack North (G1 ADV)
cards.text:
Anarch.
[MERGED] Once each round of combat, Zack can burn 1 blood to make the damage from his hand strikes aggravated that round.

cards.name: Zack North (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla: +1 strength.

cards.name: Zafira (G7)
cards.text: Anarch.

cards.name: Zahir, Hand of the Silsila (G2)
cards.text: Independent: Zahir can search your library for a contract card, reveal it, and move it to your hand as a +1 stealth action (shuffle and discard down afterward). Blood cursed.

cards.name: Zaire River Ferry
cards.text:
While in play, this equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment. Haven. Unique.
Lock as an action directed at this Lasombra is announced to have that action fail. Lock to give this Lasombra +1 stealth. A vampire can have only one haven.

cards.name: Zane (G5)
cards.title: Primogen
cards.text: Camarilla primogen: If Zane is not a prince, he can call a referendum to receive (and contest) the title held by a prince as a +1 stealth political action.

cards.name: Zapaderin
cards.text:
Only usable by a ready unlocked Ravnos other than the acting minion.
Allies and vampires younger than this modifying Ravnos get -1 intercept.
cards.flavor:
Belladonna, n. In Italian a beautiful lady; in English a deadly poison. A striking example of the essential identity of the two tongues.
Ambrose Bierce, "The Devil's Dictionary"

cards.name: Zayyat, The Sandstorm (G3)
cards.title: 2 votes
cards.text: Independent: Zayyat has 2 votes (titled). Zayyat can move up to 3 blood from himself to a younger vampire in your uncontrolled region as a +1 stealth action. Once each turn, he can burn 2 blood to get +2 stealth for the current action.

cards.name: Zbigniew, Hunter of Mekhet (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Zebulon (G1)
cards.text: Camarilla.

cards.name: Zelios (G5)
cards.title: Primogen
cards.text: Camarilla primogen: If Zelios is ready, you can lock him to pay the pool cost of a location with his blood instead. +1 strength.

cards.name: Zephyr
cards.text:
Only usable after resolution of an unsuccessful action.
[cel] Unlock this vampire at the end of the turn.
[CEL] Unlock this vampire.

cards.name: Zhara (G3)
cards.text: Laibon: The leave torpor action costs Zhara 1 less blood.

cards.name: Zhenga (G4)
cards.text: Laibon: As Zhenga announces a recruit or employ action, she can burn X blood. If the action is successful, she can recruit and employ up to X additional allies and retainers from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal).

cards.name: Zillah's Tears
cards.text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
Put this card on this acting vampire and move 1 blood from the blood bank to this vampire. This Sabbat vampire can burn this card any time after this turn ends to unlock. A vampire can have only one Zillah's Tears.
cards.flavor:
Caine's Promise is not intended for everyone, but only for his true childer, Zillah's childer, born of her tears.
Blackhorse Tanner, Ventrue antitribu

cards.name: Zillah's Valley
cards.text: Add 4 blood to a vampire in your uncontrolled region with capacity 8 or more.
cards.flavor:
And each night, for three nights, Zillah drank from her Sire, though she did not know it. And, on the third night, Caine announced he would marry Zillah, his sweetest Childe, and she agreed.
The Book of Nod

cards.name: Zip (G3)
cards.text: Sabbat.

cards.name: Zip Gun
cards.text: Before range is determined, put this card on this minion. This card represents an equipment card and doesn't count as a combat card while in play. This equipment is a weapon, gun. Ammo cards cannot be used with this gun. It does 1R damage each strike, with an optional maneuver each combat. Bearer takes 1 damage during strike resolution when striking with this gun, but only once each combat. This card is kept as normal equipment and is not discarded after combat.

cards.name: Zip Line
cards.text:
+2 stealth action.
Put this card on the acting minion. This minion may burn this card to get +1 stealth.
cards.flavor:
I have always found that plans are useless, but planning is indispensable.
Dwight Eisenhower

cards.name: Zizi (G6)
cards.text: Sabbat: If /Viri/ is in your ready region, Zizi can lock to unlock another Blood Brother of the same circle. Budapest circle. Sterile.

cards.name: Zöe (G2)
cards.text: Camarilla: Zöe does not get the usual +1 stealth when hunting.

cards.name: Zombie
cards.text:
Zombie with 2 life.
Zombie inflicts 1 damage on the opposing minion each round of combat during normal strike resolution at close range. This vampire can burn this retainer to gain 2 blood as a +1 stealth action.

cards.name: Zoning Board
cards.text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. During your master phase, you may choose a location controlled by another Methuselah. Until the end of your minion phase, any minion can move that location to its owner's library as a Ⓓ action (the owner shuffles afterward). If that action is successful, that controller gains X pool, where X is the pool cost of the location. Any vampire can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action. You may lock this card to gain 1 vote in that referendum.

cards.name: Zoo Hunting Ground
cards.text:
Unique location. Hunting ground.
During your unlock phase, a ready vampire you control can gain 1 blood. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground each turn.

cards.name: Zubeida (G5)
cards.text: Sabbat. Black Hand: Zubeida gets +1 bleed when bleeding a Methuselah who controls no ready vampires with capacity above 6. Scarce. Sterile.

cards.name: Zygodat (G4)
cards.text: Sabbat: When Zygodat successfully bleeds a Methuselah, she may burn the top two cards of that Methuselah's library.
